and praise is wont to rise;
where parents love the sacred Word
and all its wisdom prize.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: Lord, let us in our homes agree
this blessed peace to gain;
unite our hearts in love to thee,
and love to all will reign.

entries.title: O Perfect Love
entries.firstLine: O perfect Love, all human thought transcending,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: O perfect Love, all human thought transcending,
lowly we kneel in prayer before thy throne,
that theirs may be the love which knows no ending,
whom thou forevermore dost join in one.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: O perfect Life, be thou their full assurance
of tender charity and steadfast faith,
of patient hope and quiet, brave endurance,
with childlike trust that fears nor pain nor death.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Grant them the joy which brightens earthly sorrow;
grant them the peace which calms all earthly strife,
and to life's day the glorious unknown morrow
that dawns upon eternal love and life.

entries.title: O God, From Whom Mankind
entries.firstLine: O God from whom mankind derives its name;
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: O God from whom mankind derives its name;
Whose covenant of grace remains the same,
Be with these two who now before You wait;
Enlarge the love they come to consecrate.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: May through their union other lives be blessed;
Their door be wide to stranger and to guest,
Give them the understanding that is kind,
Grant them the blessing of an open mind.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Preserve their days from inwardness of hear;
To each the gift of truthful speech impart.
Their bond be strong against all strain and strife
Amid the changes of this earthly life.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: From stage to stage on life's unfolding way
Bring to their mind the vows they make this day,
Your Spirit be their Guide in every move,
Their faith in Christ the basis of their love.

entries.title: Heavenly Father, Hear Our Prayer
entries.firstLine: Heav'nly Father, hear our prayer
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Heav'nly Father, hear our prayer
As we bow before You:
Bless them in the life they share,
Humble we implore You.
Be their guide in all endeavors,
Be their hope that nothing severs;
Constant source of love divine,
Let Your love within them shine!

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: As they pledge their love this day
Here before Your altar,
May their hearts,, upon You stayed,
Never fail or falter.
Be their comfort in all sorrow;
Be their reason for tomorrow.
Grant them strength to live each hour
Trusting solely in Your pow'r.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Blest Creator, Lord of life,
Hear our glad thanksgiving.
Husband You have joined to wife
For their earthly living.
Justified by Jesus' merit,
Life eternal they inherit.
When their days on earth have passed,
Take them to Your home at last!

entries.title: May the Grace of Christ Our Savior
entries.firstLine: May the grace of Christ our Savior
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: May the grace of Christ our Savior
And the Father's boundless love,
With the Holy Spirit's favor,
Rest upon them from above.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Thus may they abide in union
With each other and the Lord,
And possess, in sweet communion,
Joys which earth cannot afford.

entries.title: Glory Be to the Father
entries.firstLine: Glory be to the Father,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Glory be to the Father,
and to the Son,
and to the Holy Ghost;
As it was in the beginning,
is now, and ever shall be,
world without end.
Amen, Amen.

entries.title: Holy, Holy, Holy
entries.firstLine: Holy, holy, holy, Holy is the Lord!
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Holy, holy, holy, Holy is the Lord!
Holy, holy, holy, Holy is our God!
He who always liveth, Evermore the same
Heav'n and earth He ruleth, Come and praise His name!

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Holy, holy, holy, Holy is the Lord!
Holy, holy, holy, Holy is our God!
Glorious adn beloved Is the One adored!
Holy, holy, holy, Holy is the Lord.

entries.title: Let All Mortal Flesh Keep Silence
entries.firstLine: Let all mortal flesh keep silence,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Let all mortal flesh keep silence,
And with fear and trembling stand;
Ponder nothing earthly-minded,
For with blessing in his hand,
Christ our God to earth descendeth,
Our full homage to demand. Amen.

entries.title: Amens
entries.firstLine: A-men, A---men.
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: A-men, A---men.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: A-----men.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: A---men.

verses.label: Verse 4
lines: A---men, (A-men.)

verses.label: Verse 5
lines: A-----men.

verses.label: Verse 6
lines: A-men, A-men, A---men.

entries.title: Sevenfold Amen
entries.firstLine: A-men,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: A-men,
A-men,
A---men,
A-----men,
A-----men,
A-----men,
A-men.

entries.title: All Things Come of Thee
entries.firstLine: All things come of thee, O Lord;
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: All things come of thee, O Lord;
and of thine own have we given thee.
Amen.

entries.title: Cast Thy Burden Upon the Lord
entries.firstLine: Cast thy burden upon the Lord,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Cast thy burden upon the Lord,
And He shall sustain thee;
He never will suffer the righteous to fall;
He is at thy right hand.
Thy mercy, Lord, is great, and far above the heavens;
Let none be made ashamed, that wait upon Thee.

entries.title: Lord, Bless Thy Word to Every Heart
entries.firstLine: Lord, bless Thy word to every heart
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Lord, bless Thy word to every heart
In this Thy house today,
And help us each as now we part,
Its precepts to obey.
Amen
Amen

entries.title: O Thou Who Hearest
entries.firstLine: O Thou who hearest every heartfelt prayer,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: O Thou who hearest every heartfelt prayer,
With Thy rich grace, Lord, all our hearts prepare;
Thou art our life, Thou art our love and light,
O let this Sabbath hour with Him be bright. Amen.

entries.title: The Lord Bless You and Keep You
entries.firstLine: The Lord bless you and keep you,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord bless you and keep you,
the Lord life His countenance upon you,
and give you peace;
the Lord make His face to shine upon you,
and be gracious unto you,
be gracious,
the Lord be gracious unto you.
Amen.

entries.title: We Give Thee But Thine Own
entries.firstLine: We give Thee but Thine own,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: We give Thee but Thine own,
What-e'er the gift may be;
All that we have is Thine alone,
A trust, O Lord, from Thee.

entries.title: As We Come to You in Prayer
entries.firstLine: Now, dear Lord, as we pray,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Now, dear Lord, as we pray,
take our hearts and minds far away
from the press of the world all around
to your throne where grace does abound.
May our lives be transformed by Your love,
may our souls be refreshed from above.
At this moment, let people everywhere
join us now as we come to You in prayer.

entries.title: Spirit of the Living God
entries.firstLine: Spirit of the living God,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Spirit of the living God,
Fall afresh on me!
Spirit of the living God,
Fall afresh on me!
Break me, melt me, mold me, fill me!
Spirit of the living God,
Fall afresh on me!

entries.title: May God Be With You
entries.firstLine: May God be with you Till we meet again,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: May God be with you Till we meet again,
May God be with you, Keep you safe till then;
And may His blessings Be within your heart,
May God be with you While we're apart,
May God be with you.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: May God be with you, Watch you from above,
May God protect you in His tender love;
And with the dawning Of each bright, new day,
May God be with you, To guide your way,
May God be with you.

entries.title: Shalom
entries.firstLine: Shalom, good friends,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Shalom, good friends,
shalom, good friends,
shalom, shalom.
Till we meet again,
till we meet again,
shalom, shalom.

entries.title: May the Lord Bless and Keep You
entries.firstLine: May the Lord bless you and keep you
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: May the Lord bless you and keep you
both now and evermore.
Amen, Amen.

entries.title: Thy Word Is a Lantern
entries.firstLine: Thy Word is a lantern unto my feet,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Thy Word is a lantern unto my feet,
And a light unto my path.

entries.title: Heavenly Father, to Thee We Pray
entries.firstLine: Heavenly Father, to Thee we pray,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Heavenly Father, to Thee we pray,
On the holy Sabbath day;
Through Thy Word Thy will make known;
May each heart become Thy throne,
Let Thy living water flow
That we Thy boundless love may know.
Amen.

entries.title: God Be in My Head
entries.firstLine: God be in my head, and in my understanding;
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: God be in my head, and in my understanding;
God be in mine eyes, and in my looking;
God be in my mouth, and in my speaking;
God be in my heart, and in my thinking;
God be at mine end, and at my departing.

entries.title: God Be in My Head
entries.firstLine: God be in my head,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: God be in my head,
And in my thinking.
god be in my eyes,
And in my looking.
God be in my mouth
And in my speaking.
Oh, God be in my hear,
And in my understanding.

entries.title: Holy Spirit, Hear Us
entries.firstLine: Holy Spirit, hear us;
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Holy Spirit, hear us;
Help us while we sing;
Breath into the music
Of the praise we bring.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Holy Spirit, prompt us
When we kneel to pray;
Nearer come, and teach us
What we ought to say.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Holy Spirit, shine Thou
On the Book we read;
Gild it's holy pages
With the light we need.

entries.title: This Is the Day the Lord Hath Made
entries.firstLine: This is the day the Lord hath made;
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: This is the day the Lord hath made;
he calls the hours his own.
Let heaven rejoice, let earth be glad,
and praise surround the throne.

entries.title: As You Have Promised, Lord
entries.firstLine: As You have promised, Lord, today,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: As You have promised, Lord, today,
You are letting Your servant go away in peace.
May eyes have seen You in broad daylight
before all nations, planning salvation.
Light of revelation for the nations,
and glory of Your people Israel.

entries.title: Jesus, Stand Among Us
entries.firstLine: Jesus, stand among us
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Jesus, stand among us
In Thy risen power;
Let this time of worship
Be a hallowed hour.

verses.label: Verse 2
lines: Breathe the Holy Spirit
Into every heart;
Bid the fears and sorrows
From each soul depart.

verses.label: Verse 3
lines: Thus with quickened footsteps
We pursue our way,
Watching for the dawning
Of eternal day.

entries.title: Hear Our Prayer, O Lord
entries.firstLine: Hear Our Prayer, O Lord,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Hear Our Prayer, O Lord,
Hear our prayer, O Lord;
Incline Thine ear to us,
And grant us Thy peace.
Amen.

entries.title: Cause Me to Hear
entries.firstLine: Cause me to hear Thy loving kindness in the morning,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Cause me to hear Thy loving kindness in the morning,
for in Thee do I trust.
Cause me to know they way where-in I shall walk
for I lift up my soul to Thee.
Amen

entries.title: Bless Thou the Gifts
entries.firstLine: Bless thou the gifts our hands have brought;
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Bless thou the gifts our hands have brought;
bless thou the work our hearts have planned.
Ours is the faith, the will, the thought;
the rest, O God, is in thy hand.
Amen.

entries.title: The Lord Is in His Holy Temple
entries.firstLine: The Lord is in HIs holy temple,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord is in HIs holy temple,
The Lord is in His holy temple,
Let all the earth be silent
be silent before Him.

entries.title: Surely, Surely
entries.firstLine: Surely, surely the Lord has been here,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Surely, surely the Lord has been here,
Surely angels still linger near;
I hear music soft on my ear,
I feel His Spirit,
I have no fear.

entries.title: Day by Day, Dear Lord
entries.firstLine: Day by day, Dear Lord, of Thee three things I pray:
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Day by day, Dear Lord, of Thee three things I pray:
To see Thee more clearly, Love Thee more dearly,
Follow Thee more nearly, Day by day.

entries.title: Dismiss Us, Lord With Blessing
entries.firstLine: Dismiss us, Lord, with blessing, we pray;
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Dismiss us, Lord, with blessing, we pray;
As from Thy worship we go our ways;
Guide in life's conflicts, all through the day;
Save in Thy kingdom, Thine be the praise.
Amen.

entries.title: Lead Me, Lord
entries.firstLine: Lead me, Lord, lead me in thy righteousness;
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Lead me, Lord, lead me in thy righteousness;
make thy way plain before my face.
For it is thou, Lord, thou, Lord only,
that makest me dwell in safety.

entries.title: The Lord Is in His Holy Temple
entries.firstLine: The Lord is in His holy temple,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: The Lord is in His holy temple,
The Lord is in His holy temple,
Let all the earth keep silence,
Let all the earth keep silence, before Him,
Keep silence, keep silence, before Him.
Amen.

entries.title: Almighty Father
entries.firstLine: Almighty Father, hear our prayer,
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Almighty Father, hear our prayer,
and bless all souls that wait before Thee.
Amen.

entries.title: Praise God, From Whom All Blessings
entries.firstLine: Praise God, from Whom all blessings flow;
entries.author: Seventh-day Adventist Hymnal (1985)

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise God, from Whom all blessings flow;
Praise Him, all creatures here below;
Praise Him above, ye heavenly host;
Praise Father, Son, and Holy Ghost.

entries.title: Praise God, From Whom All Blessings
entries.firstLine: Praise God, from Whom all blessings flow;
entries.author: Thomas Ken
entries.authorBio: Thomas Ken was an English Anglican bishop known for his integrity and courage; he composed morning, evening, and midnight hymns for students at Winchester College.
entries.story: Originally the closing stanza of Ken's 1674 morning and evening hymns for Winchester schoolboys, this four-line doxology has been sung across nearly every Christian denomination for over three centuries and concludes the hymn section of the 1985 SDA Hymnal.

verses.label: Verse 1
lines: Praise God, from Whom all blessings flow;
Praise Him, all creatures here below;
Praise Him above, ye heavenly host;
Praise Father, Son, and Holy Ghost.

entries.title: I Will Extol the Lord
entries.firstLine: I will extol the Lord at all times;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I will extol the Lord at all times;
his praise will always be on my lips.
My soul will boast in the Lord;
let the afflicted hear and rejoice.
Glorify the Lord with me;
let us exalt his name together.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: I sought the Lord, and he answered me;
He delivered me from all my fears.
Those who look to him are radiant;
their faces are never covered with shame.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: This poor man called, and the Lord heard him;
he saved him out of all his troubles
The angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear him,
And he delivers them.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Taste and see that the Lord is good;
blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.
Fear the Lord, you his saints,
for those who fear him lack nothing.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The righteous cry out, and the Lord hears them;
He delivers them from all their troubles.
The Lord is close to the broken hearted
And saves those who are crushed in spirit.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Evil will slay the wicked;
The foes of the righteous will be condemned.
The Lord Redeems his servants;
No one who takes refuge in him will be condemned.

entries.title: Shout with Joy to God, All the Earth!
entries.firstLine: Shout with joy to God, all the earth!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Shout with joy to God, all the earth!
Sing to the glory of his name;
offer him glory and praise!
Praise our God, O peoples,
let the sound of his praise be heard;
he has preserved our lives
and kept our feet from slipping.
For you, O God, tested us;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: you refined us like silver.
You brought us into prison
and laid burdens on our backs.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You let men ride over our heads;
we went through fire and water,
but you brought us to a place of abundance.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: I will come to your temple with
burnt offerings and fulfill my vows to you
vows my lips promised and my
mouth spoke when I was in trouble.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Come and listen, all you who fear God;
let me tell you what he has done for me.
I cried out to him with my mouth;
his praise was on my tongue.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: If I had cherished sin in my heart,
the Lord would not have listened;
but God has surely listened
and heard my voice in prayer.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Praise be to God, who has not rejected my prayer
or withheld his love from me!

entries.title: How Lovely Is Thy Dwelling Place
entries.firstLine: How lovely is thy dwelling place,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: How lovely is thy dwelling place,
O Lord of hosts!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: My soul longs, yea, faints
for the courts of the Lord;
my heart and flesh sing for joy
to the living God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Even the sparrow finds a home,
and the swallow a nest for herself,
where she may lay her young,
at thy altars, O Lord of hosts,
my King and my God.
Blessed are those who dwell in thy house,
ever singing thy praise!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For a day in thy courts is better
than a thousand elsewhere.
I would rather be a doorkeeper
in the house of my God
than dwell in the tents of wickedness.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For the Lord God is a sun and shield;
he bestows favor and honor.
No good thing does the Lord withhold
from those who walk uprightly.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: O Lord of hosts,
blessed is the man who trusts in thee!

entries.title: O Come, Let Us Sing Unto the Lord
entries.firstLine: O come, let us sing unto the Lord:

parts.speaker: leader
lines: O come, let us sing unto the Lord:
let us make a joyful noise
to the rock of our salvation.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving,
and make a joyful noise unto him, with psalms.
For the Lord is a great God,
and a great King above all gods.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: In his hand are the deep places of the earth:
the strength of the hills is his also.
The sea is his, and he made it:
and his hands formed the dry land.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: O come, let us worship and bow down:
let us kneel before the Lord our maker.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For he is our God;
and we are the people of his pasture,
and the sheep of his hand.

entries.title: Oh, Sing to the Lord a New Song
entries.firstLine: Oh, sing to the Lord a new song!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Oh, sing to the Lord a new song!
Sing to the Lord, all the earth.
Sing to the Lord, bless His name;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Proclaim the good news of His
salvation from day to day.
Declare His glory among the nations,
His wonders among all peoples.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For the Lord is great and greatly to be praised;
He is to be feared above all gods.
For all the gods of the peoples are idols,
But the Lord made the heavens.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Honor and majesty are before Him;
Strength and beauty are in His sanctuary.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Give to the Lord, O kindreds of the peoples,
Give to the Lord glory and strength.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Give to the Lord the glory due His name;
Bring an offering, and come into His courts.
Oh, worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness!
Tremble before Him, all the earth.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Say among the nations, "The Lord reigns;
The world also is firmly established,
It shall not be moved;
He shall judge the peoples righteously."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Let the heavens rejoice and let the earth be glad;
Let the sea roar, and all its fullness;
Let the field be joyful, and all that is in it.
Then all the trees of the woods will rejoice before the Lord.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For He is coming, for He is coming to judge the earth.
He shall judge the world with righteousness,
And the peoples with His truth.

entries.title: Shout Joyfully to the Lord
entries.firstLine: Shout joyfully to the Lord, all the earth.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Shout joyfully to the Lord, all the earth.
Serve the Lord with gladness;
Come before Him with joyful singing.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Know that the Lord Himself is God;
It is He who has made us, and not we ourselves;
We are His people and the sheep of His pasture.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Enter His gates with thanksgiving,
And His courts with praise.
Give thanks to Him; bless His name.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For the Lord is good;
His loving kindness is everlasting,
And His faithfulness to all generations.

entries.title: Give Thanks to the Lord
entries.firstLine: Oh give thanks to the Lord, call upon His name;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Oh give thanks to the Lord, call upon His name;
Make known His deeds among the peoples.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him;
Speak of all His wonders.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Glory in His holy name;
Let the heart of those who seek the Lord be glad.
Seek the Lord and His strength;
Seek His face continually.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Remember His wonders which He as done,
His marvels, and the judgments uttered by His mouth,
O seed of Abraham, His servant,
O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He is the Lord our God;
His judgments are in all the earth.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He has remembered His covenant forever,
The word which He commanded
to a thousand generations.

entries.title: Praise the Lord, You That Are His Servants
entries.firstLine: O praise the Lord.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: O praise the Lord.
Praise the Lord, you that are his servants,
praise the name of the Lord.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Blessed be the name of the Lord now and evermore.
From the rising of the sun to its setting
may the Lord's name be praised.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: High is the Lord above all nations,
his glory above the heavens.
There is none like the Lord our God
in heaven or on earth,
who sets his throne so high
but deigns to look down so low;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: who lifts the weak out of the dust
and raises the poor from the dunghill,
giving them a place among princes,
among the princes of his people;
who makes the woman in a childless
house a happy mother of children.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: O praise the Lord.

entries.title: If I Lift Up my Eyes to the Hills
entries.firstLine: If I lift up my eyes to the hills,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: If I lift up my eyes to the hills,
where shall I find help?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Help comes only from the Lord,
maker of heaven and earth.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: How could he let your foot stumble?
How could he, your guardian, sleep?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The guardian of Israel
never slumbers, never sleeps.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The Lord is your guardian,
your defence at your right hand;
the sun will not strike you by day
nor the moon by night.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The Lord will guard you against all evil;
he will guard you, body and soul.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The Lord will guard your going and
your coming, now and for evermore.

entries.title: I Will Exalt You, my God the King
entries.firstLine: I will exalt you, my God the King;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I will exalt you, my God the King;
I will praise your name for ever and ever.
Every day I will praise you
and extol your name for ever and ever.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Great is the Lord and most worthy of praise;
his greatness no one can fathom.
One generation will commend your
works to another;
they will tell of your mighty acts.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: They will celebrate your abundant goodness
and joyfully sing of your righteousness.
The Lord is gracious and compassionate,
slow to anger and rich in love.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The Lord is faithful to all his promises
and loving toward all he has made.
The Lord upholds all those who fall
and lifts up all who are bowed down.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The eyes of all look to you,
and you give them their food at the proper time.
You open your hand and satisfy the desires
of every living thing.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The Lord is righteous in all His ways
and loving toward all he has made.
The Lord is near to all who call on him,
to all who call on him in truth.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He fulfills the desires of those who fear him;
he hears their cry and saves them.
The Lord watches over all who love him,
but all the wicked he will destroy.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: My mouth will speak in praise of the Lord.
Let every creature praise his holy
name for ever and ever.

entries.title: Let Heaven Praise the Lord
entries.firstLine: Alleluia!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Alleluia!
Let heaven praise Yahweh:
praise him, heavenly heights,
praise him, all his angels,
praise him, all his armies!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Praise him, sun and moon,
praise him, shining stars,
praise him, highest heavens,
and waters above the heavens!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Let them all praise the name of Yahweh,
at whose command they were created;
he has fixed them in their place for ever,
by an unalterable statute.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Let earth praise Yahweh:
sea-monsters and all the deeps,
fire and hail, snow and mist,
gales that obey his decree,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: mountains and hills, orchards and forests,
wild animals and farm animals, snakes and birds,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: all kings on earth and nations,
princes, all rulers in the world,
young men and girls,
old people, and children too!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Let them all praise the name of Yahweh,
for his name and no other is sublime,
transcending earth and heaven in majesty,
raising the fortunes of his people,
to the praises of the devout,
of Israel, the people dear to him.

entries.title: O Praise God in His Holy Place
entries.firstLine: O praise the Lord.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: O praise the Lord.
O praise God in his holy place,
praise him in the vault of heaven,
the vault of his power;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: praise him for his mighty works,
praise him for his immeasurable greatness.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Praise him with fanfares on the trumpet,
praise him upon lute and harp;
praise him with tambourines and dancing,
praise him with flute and strings;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: praise him with the clash of cymbals,
praise him with triumphant cymbals;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: let everything that has breath praise the Lord!
O praise the Lord.

entries.title: Praise At God's Throne
entries.firstLine: Revelation 4, 15, 9, and 7 NJV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Revelation 4, 15, 9, and 7 NJV
"Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God Almighty,
who was, and is, and is to come."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "You are worthy, our Lord and God,
to receive glory and honor and power,
for you created all things,
and by your will they were created
and have their being."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: *"Great and marvelous are your deeds,
Lord God Almighty.
Just and true are your ways,
King of the ages.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Who will not fear you, O Lord,
and bring glory to your name?
For you alone are holy.
All nations wi11 come and worship before you,
for your righteous acts have been revealed."*

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Hallelujah!
Salvation and glory and power belong to our God,
for true and just are his judgments."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Amen!
Praise and glory and wisdom and thanks and honor
and power and strength be to our God
for ever and ever. Amen!"

entries.title: Trinity
entries.firstLine: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,
who has blessed us in Christ
with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: In him we have redemption through his blood,
the forgiveness of our trespasses,
according to the riches of his grace
which he lavished upon us.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: In him you also, who have heard the word of truth,
the gospel of your salvation, and have believed in him,
were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,
which is the guarantee of our inheritance
until we acquire possession of it, to the praise of his glory.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off
have been brought near in the blood of Christ.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He came and preached peace to you
who were far off and peace to those who were near;
for through him we both have access
in one Spirit to the Father.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: There is one body and one Spirit,
just as you were called to the one hope
that belongs to your call, one Lord, one faith,
one baptism, one God and Father of us all,
who is above all and through all and in all.

entries.title: Bow Down Your Ear, o Lord, Hear Me
entries.firstLine: Bow down Your ear, O Lord, hear me;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Bow down Your ear, O Lord, hear me;
For I am poor and needy. . . .
For You, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive,
And abundant in mercy to all those
who call upon You.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Give ear, O Lord, to my prayer;
And attend to the voice of my supplications.
In the day of my trouble I will call upon You,
For You will answer me. . . .
For You are great, and do wondrous things;
You alone are God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Teach me Your way, O Lord;
I will walk in Your truth;
Unite my heart to fear Your name.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: I will praise You, O Lord my God,
with all my heart,
And I will glorify Your name forevermore.
For great is Your mercy toward me,
And You have delivered my soul
from the depths of sheol.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: O God, the proud have risen against me,
And a mob of violent men have sought my life,
And have not set You before them.
But You, O Lord, are a God full

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: of compassion, and gracious,
Longsuffering and abundant in
mercy and truth.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Oh, turn "to me, and have mercy on me!
Give Your strength to Your servant,
And save the son of Your maidservant.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Show me a sign for good,
That those who hate me
may see it and be ashamed,
Because You, Lord, have helped me
and comforted me.

entries.title: Praise the Lord, o my Soul
entries.firstLine: Praise the Lord, O my soul;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Praise the Lord, O my soul;
all my inmost being, praise his holy name.
Praise the Lord, O my soul,
and forget not all his benefits.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He forgives all my sins and heals all my diseases;
he redeems my life from the pit
and crowns me with love and compassion.
He satisfies my desires with good things,
so that my youth is renewed like the eagle's.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The Lord is compassionate and gracious,
slow to anger, abounding in love. . . .
He does not treat us as our sins deserve
or repay us according to our iniquities.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For as high as the heavens are above the earth,
so great is his love for those who fear him;
as far as the east is from the west,
so far has he removed our transgressions from us.
Praise the Lord, O my soul.

entries.title: His Love Endures
entries.firstLine: It is good to give thanks to the Lord,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: It is good to give thanks to the Lord,
for his love endures for ever.*

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Give thanks to the God of gods;
his love endures for ever.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Give thanks to the Lord of lords;
his love endures for ever.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Alone he works great marvels;
his love endures for ever.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: In wisdom he made the heavens;
his love endures for ever.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He laid the earth upon the waters;
his love endures for ever.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He made the great lights,
his love endures for ever,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The sun to rule by day,
his love endures for ever,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The moon and the stars to rule by night;
his love endures for ever.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He remembered us when we were cast down,
his love endures for ever,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: and rescued us from our enemies;
his love endures for ever.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He gives food to all his creatures;
his love endures for ever.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Give thanks to the God of heaven,
for his love endures for ever.
* Alternately, the congregation may respond by reading this phrase in each couplet.

entries.title: Love of God
entries.firstLine: In this the love of God was manifested toward us,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: In this the love of God was manifested toward us,
that God has sent His only begotten
Son into the world,
that we might live through Him.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "For God did not send His Son into the world
to condemn the world,
but that the world through Him might be saved."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: In this is love, not that we loved God,
but that He loved us and sent His
Son to be the propitiation for our sins.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: God is love,
and be who abides in love abides in God,
and God in him.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Beloved, if God so loved us,
we also ought to love one another.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: If someone says, "I love God,"
and bates his brother, be is a liar;
for be who does not love his brother whom be bas seen,
bow can be love God whom be bas not seen?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And this commandment we have from Him:
that he who loves God must love his brother also.

entries.title: O Lord, How Majestic Is Your Name
entries.firstLine: O Lord, our Lord,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: O Lord, our Lord,
how majestic is your name in all the earth!
You have set your glory above the heavens.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: From the lips of children and infants
you have ordained praise
because of your enemies,
to silence the foe and the avenger.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: When I consider your heavens,
the work of your fingers,
the moon and the stars,
which you have set in place,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: what is man that you are mindful of him,
the son of man that you care for him?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You made him a little lower than the heavenly beings
and crowned him with glory and honor.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: You made him ruler over the works of your hands:
you put everything under his feet:
all locks and herds,
and the beasts of the field,
the birds of the air,
and the fish of the sea,
all that swim the paths of the seas.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: O Lord, our Lord,
how majestic is your name in all the earth!

entries.title: I Will Extol the Lord with All my Heart
entries.firstLine: Praise the Lord.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Praise the Lord.
I will extol the Lord with all my heart
in the council of the upright and in the assembly.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Great are the works of the Lord;
they are pondered by all who delight in them.
Glorious and majestic are his deeds,
and his righteousness endures forever.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He has caused his wonders to be remembered;
the Lord is gracious and compassionate.
He provides food for those who fear him;
he remembers his covenant forever.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He has shown his people the power of his works,
giving them the lands of other nations.
The works of his hands are faithful and just;
all his precepts are trustworthy.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: They are steadfast for ever and ever,
done in faithfulness and uprightness.
He provided redemption for his people;
he ordained his covenant forever
holy and awesome is his name.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The fear of the Lord
is the beginning of wisdom;
all who follow his precepts
have good understanding.
To him belongs eternal praise.

entries.title: The Liberating Creator
entries.firstLine: Isaiah -12. NEB

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Isaiah -12. NEB
Thus speaks the Lord who is God,
he who created the skies and stretched them out,
who fashioned the earth and all that grows in it,
who gave breath to its people,
the breath of life to all who walk upon it:

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: I, the Lord, have called you with righteous
purpose and taken you by the hand;
I have formed you, and appointed you
to be a light to all peoples,
a beacon for the nations,
to open eyes that are blind,
to bring captives out of prison,
out of the dungeons where they lie in darkness.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I am the Lord; the Lord is my name;
I will not give my glory to another god,
nor my praise to any idol.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: See how the first prophecies have come to pass,
and now I declare new things;
before they break from the bud
I announce them to you.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Sing a new song to the Lord,
sing his praise throughout the earth,
you that sail the sea, and all sea creatures,
and you that inhabit the coasts and islands.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Let the wilderness and its towns rejoice,
and the villages of the tribe of Kedar.
Let those who live in Sela shout for joy
and cry out from the hill-tops.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You coasts and islands, all uplift his praises;
let all ascribe glory to the Lord.
MAJESTY AND POWER: See also No.

entries.title: The Heavens Declare the Glory of God
entries.firstLine: The heavens declare the glory of God;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The heavens declare the glory of God;
the skies proclaim the work of his hands.
Day after day they pour forth speech;
night after night they display knowledge.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: There is no speech or language
where their voice is not heard.
Their voice goes out into all the earth,
their words to the ends of the world.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: In the heavens he has pitched a tent for the sun,
which is like a bridegroom
coming forth from his pavilion,
like a champion rejoicing to run his course.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: It rises at one end of the heavens
and makes its circuit to the other;
nothing is hidden from its heat.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The heavens declare the glory of God;
the skies proclaim the work of his hands.

entries.title: Rejoice in the Lord
entries.firstLine: Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Rejoice in the Lord, O you righteous!
For praise from the upright is beautiful.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Praise the Lord with the harp;
Make melody to Him with an
instrument of ten strings.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Sing to Him a new song;
Play skillfully with a shout of joy.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For the word of the Lord is right,
And all His work is done in truth.
He loves righteousness and justice;
The earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: By the word of the Lord the heavens were made,
And all the host of them by the breath of His mouth.
He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap;
He lays up the deep in storehouses.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Let all the earth fear the Lord;
Let all the inhabitants of the world
stand in awe of Him.
For He spoke, and it was done;
He commanded, and it stood fast.

entries.title: Our Lord the Creator
entries.firstLine: This is what God the Lord say--

parts.speaker: unison
lines: This is what God the Lord say--
she who created the heavens and
stretched them out,
who spread out the earth,
and all that comes out of it,
who gives breath to its people,
and life to those who walk on it.
"I am the Lord, and there is no other;
apart from me there is no God.
I will strengthen you, though you
have not acknowledged me,
so that from the rising of the sun
to the place of its setting
men may know there is none besides me.
I am the Lord, and there is no other."
"You heavens above, rain down righteousness;
let the clouds shower it down.
Let the earth open wide,
let salvation spring up,
let righteousness grow with it;
I, the Lord, have created it."
For this is what the Lord says--
he who created the heavens, he is God;
he who fashioned and made the earth, he founded it;
he did not create it to be empty,
but formed it to be inhabited--
he says:
"I am the Lord,
and there is no other. . . .
Turn to me and be saved,
all you ends of the earth;
for I am God, and there is no other."

entries.title: God Is Our Refuge and Strength
entries.firstLine: God is our refuge and strength,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: God is our refuge and strength,
A very present help in trouble.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Therefore we will not fear,
Though the earth be removed,
And though the mountains be
carried into the midst of the sea;
Though its waters roar and be troubled,
Though the mountains shake with its swelling.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: There is a river whose streams
shall make glad the city of God,
The holy place of the tabernacle of the Most High.
God is in the midst of her, she shall not be moved;
God shall help her, just at the break of dawn.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The nations raged, the kingdoms were moved;
He uttered His voice, the earth melted.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The Lord of hosts is with us;
The God of Jacob is our refuge.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Come, behold the works of the Lord,
Who has made desolations in the earth.
He makes wars cease to the end of the earth;
He breaks the bow and cuts the spear in two;
He burns the chariot in the fire.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Be still, and know that I am God;
I will be exalted among the nations,
I will be exalted in the earth!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The Lord of hosts is with us;
The God of Jacob is our refuge.

entries.title: Lord, You Have Been Our Refuge
entries.firstLine: Lord, you have been our refuge age after age.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Lord, you have been our refuge age after age.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Before the mountains were born
before the earth or the world came to birth,
you were God from all eternity and for ever.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You can turn man back into dust by saying,
"Back to what you were, you sons of men!"
To you, a thousand years are a single day,
a yesterday now over, an hour of the night.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: You brush men away like waking dreams,
they are like grass sprouting and flowering
in the morning,
withered and dry before dusk.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: We too are burnt up by your anger
and terrified by your fury;
having summoned up our sins
you inspect our secrets by your own light.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Our days dwindle under your wrath,
our lives are over in a breath
--our life lasts for seventy years,
eighty with good health,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: but they all add up to anxiety and trouble
over in a trice, and then we are gone.
Who yet has felt the full force of your fury,
or learnt to fear the violence of your rage?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Teach us to count how few days we have
and so gain wisdom of heart.

entries.title: He That Dwelleth in the Secret Place
entries.firstLine: He that dwelleth in the secret place

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He that dwelleth in the secret place
of the most High
shall abide under the shadow
of the Almighty.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: I will say of the Lord,
He is my refuge and my fortress:
my God; in him will I trust.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Surely he shall deliver thee
from the snare of the fowler,
and from the noisome pestilence.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He shall cover thee with his feathers,
and under his wings shalt thou trust:
his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night;
nor for the arrow that flieth by day;
nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness;
nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: A thousand shall fall at thy side,
and ten thousand at thy right hand;
but it shall not come nigh thee.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see
the reward of the wicked.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Because thou hast made the Lord,
which is my refuge,
even the most High, thy habitation;
there shall no evil befall thee,
neither shall any plague
come nigh thy dwelling.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For he shall give his angels charge over thee,
to keep thee in all thy ways.

entries.title: O Give Thanks to the Lord, for He Is Good
entries.firstLine: O give thanks to the Lord, for he is good;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: O give thanks to the Lord, for he is good;
for his steadfast love endures for ever!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so,
whom be bas redeemed from trouble
and gathered in from the lands,
from the east and from the west,
from the north and from the south.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Some wandered in desert wastes,
finding no way to a city to dwell in;
hungry and thirsty,
their soul fainted within them.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble,
and be delivered them from their distress;
be led them by a straight way,
till they reached a city to dwell in.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Let them thank the Lord for his steadfast love,
for his wonderful works to the sons of men!
For he satisfies him who is thirsty,
and the hungry he fills with good things.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Some sat in darkness and in gloom,
prisoners in affliction and in irons,
for they bad rebelled against the words of God,
and spurned the counsel of the Most High.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Their hearts were bowed down with hard labor;
they fell down, with none to help.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble,
and he delivered them from their distress;
he brought them out of darkness and gloom,
and broke their bonds asunder.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Let them thank the Lord for his steadfast love,
for his wonderful works to the sons of men!

entries.title: O Lord, You Have Searched Me
entries.firstLine: O Lord, You have searched me and known me.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: O Lord, You have searched me and known me.
You know my sitting down and my rising up;
You understand my thought afar off.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: You comprehend my path and my lying down,
And are acquainted with all my ways.
For there is not a word on my tongue,
But behold, O Lord, You know it altogether.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You have hedged me behind and before,
And laid Your hand upon me.
Such knowledge is too wonderful for me;
It is high, I cannot attain it.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Where can I go from Your Spirit?
Or where can I flee from Your presence?
If I ascend into heaven, You are there;
If I make my bed in hell,
behold, You are there.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: If I take the wings of the morning,
And dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea,
Even there Your hand shall lead me,
And Your right hand shall hold me.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: If I say, "Surely the darkness shall fall on me,"
Even the night shall be light about me;
Indeed, the darkness shall not hide from You,
But the night shines as the day;
The darkness and the light are both alike to You.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For You have formed my inward parts;
You have covered me in my mother's womb.
I will praise You,
for I am fearfully and wonderfully made;
Marvelous are Your works,
And that my soul knows very well.
Search me, O God, and know my heart;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Try me, and know my anxieties;
And see if there is any wicked way in me,
And lead me in the way everlasting.

entries.title: God Works for Good
entries.firstLine: I consider that our present sufferings

parts.speaker: unison
lines: I consider that our present sufferings
are not worth comparing with the glory
that will be revealed in us.
The creation waits in eager expectation
for the sons of God to be revealed.
For the creation was subjected to frustration,
not by its own choice,
but by the will of the one who subjected it,
in hope that the creation itself
will be liberated from its bondage to decay
and brought into the glorious freedom
of the children of God.
And we know that in all things
God works for me good
of those who love him,
who have been called
according to his purpose.
What, then, shall we say in response to this?
If God is for us, who can be against us?
He who did not spare his own Son,
but gave him up for us all--
how will he not also, along with him,
graciously give us all things?

entries.title: The Lord Is my Shepherd
entries.firstLine: The Lord is my shepherd;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The Lord is my shepherd;
I shall not want.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures:
he leadeth me beside the still waters.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He restoreth my soul:
he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness
for his name's sake.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Yea, though I walk through the
valley of the shadow of death,
I will fear no evil:
for thou art with me;
thy rod and thy staff they comfort me.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Thou preparest a table before me
in the presence of mine enemies:
thou anointest my head with oil;
my cup runneth over.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me
all the days of my life:
and I will dwell in the house of the
Lord for ever.

entries.title: The Lord Is my Light
entries.firstLine: The Lord is my light and my salvation;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The Lord is my light and my salvation;
Whom shall I fear?
The Lord is the strength of my life;
Of whom shall I be afraid?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: When the wicked came against me
To eat up my flesh,
My enemies and foes,
They stumbled and fell.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Though an army should encamp against me,
My heart shall not fear;
Though war should rise against me,
In this I will be confident.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: One thing I have desired of the Lord,
That will I seek:
That I may dwell in the house of the Lord
All the days of my life,
To behold the beauty of the Lord,
And to inquire in His temple.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For in the time of trouble
He shall hide me in His pavilion;
In the secret place of His tabernacle
He shall hide me;
He shall set me high upon a rock.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And now my head shall be lifted up
above my enemies all around me;
Therefore I will offer sacrifices of
joy in His tabernacle; I will sing, yes,
I will sing praises to the Lord.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: When my father and my mother forsake me,
Then the Lord will take care of me.
Teach me Your way, O Lord,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And lead me in a smooth path,
because of my enemies.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Wait on the Lord; Be of good courage,
And He shall strengthen your heart;
Wait, I say, on the Lord!

entries.title: Let the Redeemed Thank the Lord
entries.firstLine: Let [the redeemed] thank the Lord

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Let [the redeemed] thank the Lord
for his steadfast love,
for his wonderful works to the sons of men!...
And let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving,
and tell of his deeds in songs of joy!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Some went down to the sea in ships,
doing business on the great waters;
they saw the deeds of the Lord,
his wondrous works in the deep.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For he commanded, and raised the stormy wind,
which lifted up the waves of the sea.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: They mounted up to heaven,
they went down to the depths;
their courage melted away in their evil plight;
they reeled and staggered like drunken men,
and were at their wits' end.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Then they cried to the Lord in their trouble,
and he delivered them from their distress;
he made the storm be still,
and the waves of the sea were hushed.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Then they were glad because they had quiet,
and he brought them to their desired haven.
Let them thank the Lord for his steadfast love,
for his wonderful works to the sons of men!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Let them extol him in the congregation
of the people,
and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He turns rivers into a desert,
springs of water into thirsty ground,
a fruitful land into a salty waste,
because of the wickedness of its inhabitants.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He turns a desert into pools of water,
a parched land into springs of water.
And there he lets the hungry dwell,
and they establish a city to live in;
they sow fields, and plant vineyards,
and get a fruitful yield.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Whoever is wise, let him give heed
to these things;
let men consider the steadfast love
of the Lord.
GRACE AND MERCY: See also Nos.

entries.title: The Saviour Is Coming
entries.firstLine: "Comfort, yes, comfort My people!"

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Comfort, yes, comfort My people!"
Says your God.
"Speak comfort to Jerusalem,
and cry out to her,
That her warfare is ended,
That her iniquity is pardoned;
For she has received from the Lord's hand
Double for all her sins."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The voice of one crying in the wilderness:
"Prepare the way of the Lord;
Make straight in the desert
A highway for our God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Every valley shall be exalted,
And every mountain and hill shall be made low;
The crooked places shall be made straight,
And the rough places smooth;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "The glory of the Lord shall be revealed,
And all flesh shall see it together;
For the mouth of the Lord has spoken."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: O Zion,
You who bring good tidings,
Get up into the high mountain;
O Jerusalem,
You who bring good tidings,
Lift up your voice with strength,
Lift it up, be not afraid;
Say to the cities of Judah,
"Behold your God!"

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Behold, the Lord God shall come
with a strong hand,
And His arm shall rule for Him;
Behold, His reward is with Him,
And His work before Him.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He will feed I lis flock like a shepherd;
He will gather the lambs with His arm,
And carry them in His bosom,
And gently lead those who are with young.
FIRST ADVENT: See also Nos.

entries.title: The Birth of Christ
entries.firstLine: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: This is how the birth of Jesus Christ came about.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: His mother Mary was pledged to be married to Joseph,
but before they came together,
she was found to be with child
through the Holy Spirit.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: An angel of the Lord appeared to
him in a dream and said,
"Joseph son of David,
do not be afraid to take Mary home as your wife,
because what is conceived in her
is from the Holy Spirit.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "She will give birth to a son,
and you are to give him the name Jesus,
because he will save his people
from their sins."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And there were shepherds living
out in the fields nearby,
keeping watch over their flocks at night.
An angel of the Lord appeared to them,
and the glory of the Lord shone around them,
and they were terrified.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But the angel said to them,
"Do not be afraid.
I bring you good news of great joy
that will be for all the people.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Today in the town of David a Savior
has been born to you;
he is Christ the Lord.
This will be a sign to you:
You will find a baby wrapped in
strips of cloth and lying in a manger."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Suddenly a great company of the heavenly host
appeared with the angel, praising God and saying,
"Glory to God in the highest,
and on earth peace to men
on whom his favor rests."

entries.title: The Visit of the Wise Men
entries.firstLine: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea
in the days of Herod the king, behold,
wise men from the East came to Jerusalem, saying,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Where is he who has been born king of the Jews?
For we have seen his star in the East,
and have come to worship him."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: When Herod the king heard this,
he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him;
and assembling all the chief priests
and scribes of the people,
he inquired of them where the Christ was to be born.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: They told him, "In Bethlehem of Judea;
for so it is written by the prophet:
'And you, O Bethlehem, in the land of Judah,
are by no means least among the rulers of Judah;
for from you shall come a ruler
who will govern my people Israel.'"

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Then Herod summoned the wise men secretly
and ascertained from them
what time the star appeared;
and he sent them to Bethlehem, saying,
"Go and search diligently for the child,
and when you have found him bring me word,
that I too may come and worship him."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: When they had heard the king they went their way;
and lo, the star which they had seen in the East
went before them,
till it came to rest over the place
where the child was.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: When they saw the star, they rejoiced
exceedingly with great joy;
and going into the house they saw
the child with Mary his mother,
and they fell down and worshiped him.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Then, opening their treasures,
they offered him gifts,
gold and frankincense and myrrh.
BIRTH: See also Nos.

entries.title: Jesus' Prayer for His Disciples
entries.firstLine: "Father, the time has come.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Father, the time has come.
Glorify your Son,
that your Son may glorify you."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Now this is eternal life:
that they may know you, the only true God,
and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "I have revealed you to those
whom you gave me out of the world.
They were yours; you gave them to me
and they have obeyed your word."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "I pray for them.
I am not praying for the world,
but for those you have given me, for
they are yours....
Glory has come to me through them."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Holy Father, protect them
by the power of your name--
the name you gave me--
so that they may be one as we are one."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "I am coming to you now,
but I say these things
while I am still in the world,
so that they may have the full
measure of my joy within them."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "My prayer is not that you take them
out of the world but that you protect them
from the evil one.
They are not of the world,
even as 1 am not of it.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Sanctify them by the truth;
your word is truth.
As you sent me into the world,
I have sent them into the world.
For them I sanctify myself,
that they too may be truly sanctified.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "My prayer is not for them alone.
I pray also for those who will believe
in me through their message,
that all of them may be one, Father,
just as you are in me and 1 am in you."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "May they be brought to complete unity
to let the world know that you sent me
and have loved them even as you have loved me.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Father, 1 want those you have given me
to be with me where 1 am, and to see my glory,
the glory you have given me because you loved me
before the creation of the world."
LIFE AND MINISTRY: See also No.

entries.title: Christ's Sufferings and Death - I
entries.firstLine: Who has believed our message,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Who has believed our message,
and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He grew up before him like a tender shoot,
and like a root out of dry ground.
He had no beauty or majesty
to attract us to him,
nothing in his appearance
that we should desire him.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He was despised and rejected by men,
a man of sorrows, and familiar with suffering.
Like one from whom men hide their faces
he was despised, and we esteemed him not.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Surely he took up our infirmities
and carried our sorrows,
yet we considered him stricken by God,
smitten by him, and afflicted.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: But he was pierced for our transgressions,
he was crushed for our iniquities;
the punishment that brought us peace was upon him,
and by his wounds we are healed.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: We all, like sheep, have gone astray,
each of us has turned to his own way;
and the Lord has laid on him
the iniquity of us all.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He was oppressed and afflicted,
yet he did not open his mouth;
he was led like a lamb to the slaughter,
and as a sheep before her shearers is silent,
so he did not open his mouth.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: By oppression and judgment, he was taken away.
And who can speak of his descendants?
For he was cut off from the land of the living;
for the transgression of my people he was stricken.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He was assigned a grave with the wicked,
and with the rich in his death,
though he had done no violence,
nor was any deceit in his mouth.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Yet it was the Lord's will to crush
him and cause him to suffer,
and though the Lord makes his life a guilt offering,
he will see his offspring and prolong his days,
and the will of the Lord will prosper in his hand.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: After the suffering of his soul,
he will see the light of life and be satisfied;
by his knowledge my righteous servant
will justify many,
and he will bear their iniquities.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Therefore I will give him a portion among the great,
and he will divide the spoils with the strong,
because he poured out his life unto death,
and was numbered with the transgressors.
For he bore the sin of many,
and made intercession for the transgressors.

entries.title: Christ's Sufferings and Death-Ii
entries.firstLine: Early in the morning,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Early in the morning,
all the chief priests and the elders of the people
came to the decision to put Jesus to death.
They bound him, led him away and handed
him over to Pilate, the governor.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "What shall I do, then,
with Jesus who is called Christ?" Pilate asked.
They all answered, "Crucify him!" "Why?
What crime has he committed?" asked Pilate.
But they shouted all the louder, "Crucify him!"

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Then he released Barabbas to them.
But he had Jesus flogged,
and handed him over to be crucified.
Then the governor's soldiers took Jesus
into the Praetorium and gathered the whole
company of soldiers around him.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,
and then wove a crown of thorns and
set it on his head.
They put a staff in his right hand and
knelt in front of him and mocked him.
"Hail, King of the Jews!" they said.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: They spit on him,
and took the staff and struck him on the head
again and again. After they had mocked him,
they took off the robe and put his own clothes on him.
Then they led him away to crucify him.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And when Jesus had cried out again
in a loud voice, he gave up his spirit.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: At that moment the curtain of the temple
was torn in two from top to bottom.
The earth shook and the rocks split.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: When the centurion and those with him who
were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake
and all that had happened,
they were terrified, and exclaimed,
"Surely he was the Son of God!"
SUFFERINGS AND DEATH: See also No.

entries.title: The Resurrection of Jesus
entries.firstLine: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the

parts.speaker: leader
lines: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the
first day of the week,
Mary Magdalene and the other Mary
went to look at the tomb.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: There was a violent earthquake,
for an angel of the Lord came down
from heaven and, going to the tomb,
rolled back the stone and sat on it.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: His appearance was like lightning,
and his clothes were white as snow.
The guards were so afraid of him that they
shook and became like dead men.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The angel said to the women, "Do not be afraid,
for I know that you are looking for Jesus,
who was crucified.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "He is not here; he has risen, just as he said....
Go quickly and tell his disciples:
'He has risen from the dead.'"

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: So the women hurried away from the tomb,
afraid yet filled with joy,
and ran to tell his disciples.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Suddenly Jesus met them. "Greetings," he said.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: They came to him, clasped his feet and worshiped him.
This reading and the following can be combined as one reading.

entries.title: The Glorified Christ
entries.firstLine: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them,
he was taken up into heaven
and he sat at the right hand of God.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: If Christ has not been raised,
our preaching is useless and so is your faith....
But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead,
the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Among the lampstands was someone "like a son of man,"
dressed in a robe reaching down to his feet
and with a golden sash around his chest.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: His head and hair were white like wool,
as white as snow,
and his eyes were like blazing fire.
His feet were like bronze glowing in a furnace,
and his voice was like the sound of rushing waters.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: In his right hand he held seven stars,
and out of his mouth came a sharp double-edged sword.
His face was like the sun shining in all its brilliance.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: When I saw him, I fell at his feet as though dead.
Then he placed his right hand on me and said:

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Do not be afraid. I am the First and the Last.
I am the Living One; I was dead,
and behold I am alive for ever and ever!
And I hold the keys of death and Hades."

entries.title: The Ascension
entries.firstLine: and gave ample proof that he was alive:

parts.speaker: leader
lines: and gave ample proof that he was alive:
over a period of forty days he appeared to them
and taught them about the kingdom of God.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: While he was in their company he told them
not to leave Jerusalem. "You must wait," he said,
"for the promise made by my Father,
about which you have heard me speak:

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "John, as you know, baptized with water,
but you will be baptized with the
Holy Spirit, and within the next few days."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: So, when they were all together,
they asked him, "Lord, is this the time
when you are to establish once
again the sovereignty of Israel?"

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He answered,
"It is not for you to know about dates or times,
which the Father has set within his own control.
But you will receive power when the
Holy Spirit comes upon you;
and you will bear witness for me in Jerusalem,
and all over Judaea and Samaria,
and away to the ends of the earth."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: When he had said this, as they watched,
he was lifted up, and a cloud removed him from
their sight. As he was going,
and as they were gazing intently into the sky,
all at once there stood beside them
two men in white who said,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Men of Galilee,
why stand there looking up into the sky?
This Jesus, who has been taken away
from you up to heaven,
will come in the same way as you
have seen him go."
RESURRECTION AND ASCENSION: See also No.

entries.title: Our Understanding Priest
entries.firstLine: We see Jesus,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: We see Jesus,
who was made a little lower than the angels,
now crowned with glory and honor
because he suffered death,
so that by the grace of God
he might taste death for everyone.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For this reason he had to be made
like his brothers in every way,
in order that he might become a merciful
and faithful high priest in service to God,
and that he might make atonement for
the sins of the people.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Because he himself suffered
when he was tempted,
he is able to help those
who are being tempted.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Therefore, since we have a great high priest
who has gone through the heavens,
Jesus the Son of God,
let us hold firmly to the faith we profess....
Let us then approach the throne of
grace with confidence,
so that we may receive mercy and
find grace to help us in our time of need.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: We have this hope as an anchor for
the soul, firm and secure.

entries.title: Christ's Priesthood
entries.firstLine: Now the point in what we are saying is this:

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Now the point in what we are saying is this:
we have such a high priest,
one who is seated at the right hand
of the throne of the Majesty in heaven,
a minister in the sanctuary and the true tent
which is set up not by man but by the Lord.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For every high priest is appointed
to offer gifts and sacrifices;
hence it is necessary for this priest also
to have something to offer.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Now 'if he were on earth,
he would not be a priest at all,
since there are priests
who offer gifts according to the law.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But when Christ appeared as a high priest
of the good things that have come,
then through the greater and more perfect tent
(not made with hands, that is, not of this creation)
he entered once for all into the Holy Place,
taking not the blood of goats and
calves but his own blood,
thus securing an eternal redemption.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For Christ has entered,
not into a sanctuary made with hands,
a copy of the true one, but into heaven itself,
now to appear in the presence of God on our behalf.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Nor was it to offer himself repeatedly,
as the high priest enters the Holy Place
yearly with blood not his own;
for then he would have had to suffer repeatedly
since the foundation of the world.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: But as it is, he has appeared
once for all at the end of the age
to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And just as it is appointed for men to die once,
and after that comes judgment, so Christ,
having been offered once to bear the sins of many,
will appear a second time,
not to deal with sin but to save those
who are eagerly waiting for him.
PRIESTHOOD: See also No.

entries.title: Christ the Deliverer
entries.firstLine: This is what the Lord says-

parts.speaker: leader
lines: This is what the Lord says-
he who created you, O Jacob,
he who formed you, O Israel:
"Fear not, for I have redeemed you;
I have called you by name; you are mine.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "When you pass through the waters,
I will be with you;
and when you pass through the rivers,
they will not sweep over you.
When you walk through the fire,
you will not be burned;
the flames will not set you ablaze.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "For I am the Lord, your God,
the Holy One of Israel, your Savior....
Since you are precious and honored in my sight,
and because 1 love you,
I will give men in exchange for you,
and people in exchange for your life.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Do not be afraid, for I am with you;
I will bring your children from
the east and gather you from the west.
I will say to the north, 'Give them up!'
and to the south, 'Do not hold them back.'

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Bring my sons from afar
and my daughters from the ends of the earth-
everyone who is called by my name,
whom I created for my glory,
whom I formed and made."

entries.title: The Shepherd Cares for His People
entries.firstLine: These are the words of the Lord God:

parts.speaker: unison
lines: These are the words of the Lord God:
Now I myself will ask after my sheep
and go in search of them.
As a shepherd goes in search of his sheep
when his Hock is dispersed all around him,
so I will go in search of my sheep and rescue them,
no matter where they were scattered
in dark and cloudy days.
I will bring them out from every nation,
gather them in from other lands,
and lead them home to their own soil.
I will graze them on the mountains of Israel,
by her streams and in all her green fields.
I will feed them on good grazing-ground,
and their pasture shall be the high
mountains of Israel.
There they will rest, there in good pasture,
and find rich grazing on the mountains of Israel.
I myself will tend my flock,
I myself pen them in their fold,
says the Lord God.
I will search for the lost, recover the straggler,
bandage the hurt, strengthen the sick,
leave the healthy and strong to play,
and give them their proper food.

entries.title: The Lord Works Justice
entries.firstLine: The Lord works vindication and justice

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The Lord works vindication and justice
for all who are oppressed.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He made known his ways to Moses,
his acts to the people of Israel.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: As far as the east is from the west,
so far does he remove our transgressions from us.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: As a father pities his children,
so the Lord pities those who fear him.
For he knows our frame;
he remembers that we are dust.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: As for man, his days are like grass;
he flourishes like a flower of the field;
for the wind passes over it,
and it is gone,
and its place knows it no more.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But the steadfast love of the Lord
is from everlasting to everlasting
upon those who fear him,
and his righteousness to children's children,
to those who keep his covenant
and remember to do his commandments.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The Lord has established his throne
in the heavens, and his kingdom rules over all.
Bless the Lord, O you his angels,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: you mighty ones who do his word,
hearkening to the voice of his word!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Bless the Lord, all his hosts,
his ministers that do his will!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Bless the Lord, all his works,
in all places of his dominion.
Bless the Lord, O my soul!

entries.title: Seeking the Lost
entries.firstLine: "What man among you,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "What man among you,
if he has a hundred sheep
and has lost one of them,
does not leave the ninety-nine
in the open pasture,
and go after the one which is lost,
until he finds it?"
"And when he comes home,
he calls together his friends
and his neighbors, saying to them,
'Rejoice with me,
for I have found my sheep which was lost!'
"I tell you that in the same way,
there will be more joy in heaven
over one sinner who repents,
than over ninety-nine righteous persons
who need no repentance.
"Or what woman, if she has ten silver coins
and loses one coin, does not light a lamp
and sweep the house
and search carefully until she finds it?
"And when she has found it,
she calls together her friends and neighbors,
saying, 'Rejoice with me,
for 1 have found the coin which I had lost!'
"In the same way, I tell you,
there is joy in the presence
of the angels of God
over one sinner who repents."

entries.title: The Good Shepherd
entries.firstLine: "I tell you most solemnly,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "I tell you most solemnly,
anyone who does not enter the
sheepfold through the gate,
but gets in some other way
is a thief and a brigand.
"The one who enters through the gate
is the shepherd of the flock;
the gatekeeper lets him in,
the sheep hear his voice,
one by one he calls his own sheep
and leads them out.
"When he has brought out his flock,
he goes ahead of them,
and the sheep follow because they
know his voice.
"They never follow a stranger
but run away from him:
they do not recognize the voice of strangers."
"I tell you most solemnly,
I am the gate of the sheepfold.
All others who have come
are thieves and brigands;
but the sheep took no notice of them.
"I am the gate.
Anyone who enters through me will be safe:
he will go freely in and out
and be sure of finding pasture.
"The thief comes only to steal and
