kill and destroy.
I have come so that they may have life
and have it to the full.
"I am the good shepherd:
the good shepherd is one who lays
down his life for his sheep.
"The hired man, since he is not the shepherd
and the sheep do not belong to him,
abandons the sheep and runs away
as soon as he sees a wolf coming,
and then the wolf attacks and
scatters the sheep;
this is because he is only a hired man
and has no concern for the sheep.
"I am the good shepherd;
I know my own and my own know me,
just as the Father knows me
and I know the Father;
and I lay down my life for my sheep.
"And there are other sheep I have
that are not of this fold,
and these I have to lead as well.
They too will listen to my voice,
and there will be only one flock,
and one shepherd."

entries.title: The Christian's Assurance
entries.firstLine: This is the assurance we have
entries.scriptureRef: 1 John 5, Colossians 1, Galatians 4, and Romans 8, NJV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: This is the assurance we have
in approaching God:
that if we ask anything according
to his will, he hears us.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For he has rescued us from the dominion
of darkness and brought us into the kingdom
of the Son he loves,
in whom we have redemption,
the forgiveness of sins.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Because you are sons,
God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts,
the Spirit, who calls out,
Abba
, Father."
So you are no longer a slave,
but a son; and since you are a son,
God has made you also an heir.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: What, then, shall we say in response to this?
If God is for us, who can be against us?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Christ Jesus, who died more than that,
who was raised to life is at the right hand
of God and is also interceding for us.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ?
Shall trouble or hardship or persecution
or famine or nakedness or danger or sword?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: As it is written:
"For your sake we face death all day long;
we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered."
No, in all these things we are more
than conquerors through him who loved us.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For I am convinced that neither death nor life,
neither angels nor demons,
neither the present nor the future,
nor any powers, neither height nor depth,
nor anything else in all creation,
will be able to separate us
from the love of God
that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: This section, Paul's Song of Assurance, is one of the New Testament canticles.
LOVE OF CHRIST FOR US: See also Nos. 713, 772, 782, 800, 807.

entries.title: Signs of Christ's Coming
entries.firstLine: When [Jesus] was sitting on the Mount of Olives

parts.speaker: unison
lines: When [Jesus] was sitting on the Mount of Olives
the disciples came and asked him privately,
"Tell us, when is this going to happen,
and what will be the sign of your coming
and of the end of the world?"
And Jesus answered them,
"Take care that no one deceives you;
because many will come using my name and saying,
'I am the Christ,' and they will deceive many.
"You will hear of wars and rumors of wars;
do not be alarmed, for this is something
that must happen, but the end will not be yet.
For nation will fight against nation,
and kingdom against kingdom.
There will be famines and
earthquakes here and there....
Then they will hand you over to be
tortured and put to death;
and you will be hated by all the nations
on account of my name."
"This Good News of the kingdom
will be proclaimed to the whole world
as a witness to all the nations.
And then the end will come."
"There will be great distress such as,
until now, since the world began,
there never has been, nor ever will be again...
False Christs and false prophets will arise
and produce great signs and portents,
enough to deceive even the chosen,
if that were possible.
There, I have forewarned you."
"Immediately after the distress of those days
the sun will be darkened,
the moon will lose its brightness,
the stars will fall from the sky and
the powers of heaven will be shaken.
"And then the sign of the Son of Man
will appear in heaven;
then too all the peoples of the earth
will beat their breasts;
and they will see the Son of Man coming
on the clouds of heaven with power
and great glory.
"And he will send his angels with a loud trumpet
to gather his chosen from the four winds,
from one end of heaven to the other."

entries.title: Christ's Second Coming
entries.firstLine: John 14, Acts 1, and Matthew 24 KJV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: John 14, Acts 1, and Matthew 24 KJV
Let not your heart be troubled:
ye believe in God, believe also in me.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: In my Father's house are many mansions:
if it were not so, I would have told you.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I go to prepare a place for you.
And if I go and prepare a place for you,
I will come again,
and receive you unto myself;
that where I am, there ye may be also.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: While they looked stedfastly toward
heaven as he went up, behold,
two men stood by them in white apparel;
which also said,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Ye men of Galilee,
Why stand ye gazing up into heaven?
this same Jesus, which is taken up
from you into heaven,
shall so come in like manner
as ye have seen him go into heaven.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Watch therefore:
for ye know not what hour your Lord doth come.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: But know this, that if the goodman
of the house had known in what watch
the thief would come, he would have watched,
and would not have suffered his house
to be broken up.
Therefore be ye also ready:
for in such an hour as ye think not
the Son of man cometh.
Who then is a faithful andwise serand wiser>
whom his Lord hath made ruler over

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: his household,
to give them meat in due season?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Blessed is that servant,
whom his Lord when he cometh
shall Lind so doing.
SECOND ADVENT: See also Nos.

entries.title: Reward of the Saints
entries.firstLine: The desert and the parched land will be glad;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The desert and the parched land will be glad;
the wilderness will rejoice and blossom.
Like the crocus, it will burst into bloom;
it will rejoice greatly and shout for joy.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The glory of Lebanon will be given to it,
the splendor of Carmel and Sharon;
they will see the glory of the Lord,
the splendor of our God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Strengthen the feeble hands,
steady the knees that give way;
say to those with fearful hearts,
"Be strong, do not fear;
your God will come,
he will come with vengeance;
with divine retribution
he will come to save you."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Then will the eyes of the blind be opened
and the ears of the deaf unstopped.
Then will the lame leap like a deer,
and the tongue of the dumb shout for joy.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Water will gush forth in the wilderness
and Streams in the desert.
The burning sand will become a pool,
the thirsty ground bubbling springs.
In the haunts where jackals once lay,
grass and reeds and papyrus will grow.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And a highway will be there;
it will be called the Way of Holiness.
The unclean will not journey on it;
it will be for those who walk in that Way;
wicked fools will not go about on it.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: No lion will be there,
nor will any ferocious beast get up on it;
they will not be found there.
But only the redeemed will walk there,
and the ransomed of the Lord will return.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: They will enter Zion with singing;
everlasting joy will crown their heads.
Gladness and joy will overtake them,
and sorrow and sighing will flee away.

entries.title: A Song of Triumph
entries.firstLine: I looked and there before me was a

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I looked and there before me was a
great multitude that no one could count,
from every nation, tribe, people and language,
standing before the throne and in front of the Lamb.
They were wearing white robes
and were holding palm branches in their hands.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And they cried out in a loud voice:
"Salvation belongs to our God,
who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: All the angels were standing around the throne
and around the elders and the four living creatures.
They fell down on their faces before the throne
and worshiped God, saying:

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Amen! Praise and glory and wisdom and
thanks and honor and power and strength
be to our God for ever and ever. Amen!"

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Then one of the elders asked me,
"These in white robes who are they,
and where did they come from?"
I answered, "Sir, you know."
And he said, "These are they who
have come out of the great tribulation;
they have washed their robes and made them white
in the blood of the Lamb. Therefore,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "they are before the throne of God
and serve him day and night in his temple;
and he who sits on the throne
will spread his tent over them.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Never again will they hunger;
never again will they thirst.
The sun will not beat upon them,
nor any scorching heat.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "For the Lamb at the center of
the throne will be their shepherd;
he will lead them to springs of living water.
And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes."
KINGDOM AND REIGN
KINGDOM AND REIGN

entries.title: Reigning Forever with God
entries.firstLine: "I am the Alpha and the Omega,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "I am the Alpha and the Omega,
The beginning and the end.
I will give of the fountain of the water
of life freely to him who thirsts.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "He who overcomes shall inherited all thins,
and I will be his God and he shall be My son."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And he showed me a pure river of water of life,
clear as crystal, proceeding from the throne
of God and of the Lamb.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: In the middle of its street,
and on either side of the river,
was the tree of life,
which bore twelve fruits every month.
And the leaves of the tree were for
the healing of the nations.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And there shall be no more curse,
but the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it,
and His servants shall serve Him.
They shall see His face,
and His name shall be on their foreheads.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And there shall be no night there,
they need no lamp for light of the sun,
for the Lord god gives them light,
And they shall reign forever and ever.
KINGDOM AND REIGN: see also, No.
*May be effectively combined with No.

entries.title: O Lord, Thou Art my God
entries.firstLine: O Lord, thou art my God;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: O Lord, thou art my God;
I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name;
for thou hast done wonderful things;
thy counsels of old are faithfulness and truth.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Thou hast been a strength to the poor,
a strength to the needy in his distress,
a refuge from the storm,
a shadow from the heat,
when the blast of the terrible ones
is as a storm against the wall.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He will swallow up death in victory;
and the Lord God will wipe away
tears from off all faces;
and the rebuke of his people
shall he take away from all the earth:
for the Lord hath spoken it.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And it shall be said in that day,
Lo, this is our God;
we have waited for him,
and he will save us: this is the Lord.
we have waited for him,
we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.
GLORY AND PRAISE: see also, Nos.

entries.title: The Holy Spirit
entries.firstLine: "I will pray the Father,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "I will pray the Father,
and he will give you another Counselor,
to be with you for ever,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "even the Spirit of truth,
whom the world cannot receive,
because it neither sees him nor knows him;
you know him, for he dwells with you,
and will be in you.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "I will not leave you desolate;
I will come to you."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Nevertheless I tell you the truth:
it is to your advantage that I go away,
for if I do not go away,
the Counselor will not come to you;
but if I go, I will send him to you.
"And when he comes, he will convince
the world concerning sin and
righteousness and judgment:

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "concerning sin, because they do
not believe in me; concerning righteousness,
because I go to the Father,
and you will see me no more;
concerning judgment,
because the ruler of this world is judged."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "When the Spirit of truth comes,
he will guide you into all the truth;
for he will not speak on his own authority,
but whatever he hears he will speak,
and he will declare to you
the things that are to come.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "He will glorify me,
for he will take what is mine
and declare it to you."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "But when the Counselor comes,
whom I shall send to you from the Father,...
he will bear witness to me."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit,
whom the Father will send in my name,
be will teach you all things,
and bring to your remembrance
all that I have said to you."
HOLY SPIRIT: See also Nos.

entries.title: God's Word
entries.firstLine: How can a youth remain pure?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: How can a youth remain pure?
By behaving as your word prescribes.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: I bave sougbt you with all my beart,
do not let me stray from your commandments.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I have treasured your promises in my heart,
since I have no wish to sin against you.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: How blessed are you, Yahweb!
Teacb me your statutes!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: With my lips I have repeated them,
all these rulings from your own mouth.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: In the way of your decrees lies my joy,
a joy beyond all wealth.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I mean to meditate on your precepts
and to concentrate on your paths.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: I find my deligbt in your statutes,
I do not forget your word.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Open my eyes: I shall concentrate
on the marvels of your Law.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Now your word is a lamp to my feet,
a light to my path.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: As your word unfolds, it gives light,
and the simple understand.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Faithfulness is the essence of your word,
your righteous rulings bold good for ever.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Universal peace for those who love your Law,
no stumbling-blocks for them!

entries.title: The Holy Scriptures
entries.firstLine: Deuteronomy 29, 2 Peter 1,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Deuteronomy 29, 2 Peter 1,
2 Timothy 3, John 5, Hebrews 4,
and Jeremiah 15, NKJV
The secret things belong to the
Lord our God, but those things which are
revealed belong to us and to our'
children forever, that we may do all
the words of this law.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: We also have the prophetic word made more sure,
which you do well to heed as a light that shines
in a dark place, until the day dawns
and the morning star rises in your hearts;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: knowing this first,
that no prophecy of Scripture
is of any private interpretation,
for prophecy never came by the will of man,
but holy men of God spoke as they
were moved by the Holy Spirit.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: From childhood you have known
the Holy Scriptures,
which are able to make you wise
for salvation through faith
which is in Christ Jesus.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: All Scripture is given by inspiration of God,
and is profitable for doctrine,
for reproof, for correction,
for instruction in righteousness,
that the man of God may be complete,
thoroughly equipped for every good work.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "You search the Scriptures,
for in them you think you have eternal life;
and these are they which testify of Me."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The word of God is living and powerful,
and sharper than any two-edged sword,
piercing even to the division
of soul and spirit,
and of joints and marrow,
and is a discerner of the thoughts
and intents of the heart.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Your words were found, and I ate them,
And Your word was to me
the joy and rejoicing of my heart.

entries.title: The Call
entries.firstLine: Oh, come to the water all you who are thirsty;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Oh, come to the water all you who are thirsty;
though you have no money, come! Buy corn without money,
and eat, and, at no cost, wine and milk.
Why spend money on what is not bread,
your wages on what fails to satisfy?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Listen, listen to me,
and you will have good things to eat
and rich food to enjoy.
Pay attention, come to me; listen,
and your soul will live.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Withyou I will make an everlasting covenant
out of the favours promised to David.
See, I have made of you a witness to the peoples,
a leader and a master of the nations.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: See, you will summon a nation you never knew,
those unknown will come burrying
to you, for the sake of Yahweh your God,
of the Holy One of Israel
who will glorify you.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Seek Yahweh while he is still to be found,
call to him while he is still near.
Let the wicked man abandon his way,
the evil man his thoughts.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Let him turn back to Yahweh
who will take pity on him,
to our God who is rich in forgiving;
for my thoughts are not your thoughts,
my ways not your ways
it is Yahweh who speaks.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Yes, the heavens are as high above earth
as my ways are above your ways,
my thoughts above your thoughts.
INVITATION: See also No.

entries.title: Have Mercy On Me, o God
entries.firstLine: Have mercy on me, O God,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Have mercy on me, O God,
according to your unfailing love;
according to your great compassion
blot out my transgressions.
Wash away an my iniquity
and cleanse me from my sin.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For I know my transgressions,
and my sin is always before me.
Against you, you only, have I sinned
and done what is evil in your sight,
so that you are proved right when you speak
and justified when you judge.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Surely I have been a sinner from birth,
sinful from the time my mother conceived me.
Surely you desire truth in the inner parts;
you teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Cleanse me with hyssop, and I will be clean;
wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Let me hear joy and gladness;
let the bones you have crushed rejoice.
Hide your face from my sins
and blot out all my iniquity.
Create in me a pure heart, O God,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: and renew a steadfast spirit within me.
Do not cast me from your presence
or take your Holy Spirit from me.
Restore to me the joy of your salvation
and grant me a willing spirit, to sustain me.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Then I will teach transgressors your ways,
and sinners will turn back to you.
Save me from blood guilt,
O God, the God who saves me;
and my tongue will sing of your righteousness.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: O Lord, open my lips,
and my mouth will declare your praise.
You do not delight in sacrifice
or I would bring it;
you do not take pleasure in burnt offerings.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit;
a broken and contrite heart,
O God, you will not despise.

entries.title: Returning to God
entries.firstLine: "There was once a man who had two sons;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "There was once a man who had two sons;
and the younger said to his father,
'Father, give me my share of the property.'
So he divided his estate between them.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "A few days later the younger son
turned the whole of his share into cash
and left home for a distant country,
where he squandered it in reckless living."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "He had spent it all,
when a severe famine fell upon that country
and he began to feel the pinch.
So he went and attached himself
to one of the local landowners,
who sent him on to his farm to mind the pigs.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "He would have been glad to fill his belly
with the pods that the pigs were eating;
and no one gave him anything.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Then he came to his senses and said,
'How many of my father's paid servants
have more food than they can eat,
and here am I, starving to death!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "'I will set off and go to my father,
and say to him,
"Father, I have sinned, against God
and against you;
I am no longer lit to be called your son;
treat me as one of your paid servants."
So he set out for his father's house.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "But while he was still a long
way off his father saw him,
and his heart went out to him.
He ran to meet him, flung his arms round him,
and kissed him.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "The son said, 'Father, I have sinned,
against God and against you;
I am no longer lit to be called your son.'

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "But the father said to his servants,
'Quick! fetch a robe, my best one,
and put it on him;
put a ring on his finger and shoes on his feet.
Bring the fatted calf and kill it,
and let us have a feast to celebrate the day.
For this son of mine was dead and
has come back to life;
he was lost and is found.'

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "And the festivities began."

entries.title: Blessed Is He Whose Transgressions Are Forgiven
entries.firstLine: Blessed is he whose transgressions

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Blessed is he whose transgressions
are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
Blessed is the man whose sin the
Lord does not count against him
and in whose spirit is no deceit.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: When I kept silent, my bones wasted
away through my groaning all day long.
For day and night your hand was heavy upon me;
my strength was sapped as in the heat of summer.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Then I acknowledged my sin to you
and did not cover up my iniquity.
I said, "I will confess my transgressions
to the Lord" and you forgave the guilt of my sin.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Therefore let everyone who is godly
pray to you while you may be found;
surely when the mighty waters rise,
they will not reach him.
You are my hiding place; you will protect me
from trouble and surround me with
songs of deliverance.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I will instruct you and teach you
in the way you should go;
I will counsel you and watch over you.
FORGIVENESS: See also Nos.
CONSECRATION: See also No.

entries.title: Baptism
entries.firstLine: Jesus answered, "Truly, truly, I say to you,
entries.scriptureRef: John 3,1 Corinthians 12, Romans 6, and Matthew 28, RSV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Jesus answered, "Truly, truly, I say to you,
unless one is born of water and the Spirit,
he cannot enter the kingdom of God."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: By one spirit we were all baptized
into one body Jews or Greeks,
slaves or free and all were made to drink
of one Spirit.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Do you not know that all of us who
have been baptized into Christ Jesus
were baptized into his death?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: We were buried therefore with him
by baptism into death,
so that as Christ was raised from the
dead by the glory of the Father,
we too might walk in newness of life.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For if we have been united with him
in a death like his,
we shall certainly be united with him
in a resurrection like his.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: We know that our old self was crucified with him
so that the sinful body might be destroyed,
and we might no longer be enslaved to sin.
For he who has died is freed from sin.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Go therefore and make disciples of all nations,
baptizing them in the name of the
Father and of the Son and of the
Holy Spirit, teaching them to observe
all that I have commanded you;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "and lo, I am with you always,
to the close of the age."

entries.title: Times of Beginning
entries.firstLine: In the beginning God created the
entries.scriptureRef: Genesis 1, John 1, Romans 3, 2 Corinthians 5, and Isaiah 65, NIV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: In the beginning God created the
heavens and the earth....'
God saw all that he had made,
and it was very good.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: In the beginning was the Word,
and the Word was with God,
and the Word was God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: In him was life,
and that life was the light of men.
The Word became flesh'
and lived for a while among us.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: We have seen his glory,
the glory of the one and only Son,
who came from the Father,
full of grace and truth.
All have sinned and fall
short of the glory of God,
and are justified freely
by his grace through the redemption
that came by Christ Jesus.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Therefore, if anyone is in Christ,
he is a new creation;
the old has gone, the new has come!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Behold, I will create
new heavens and a new earth.
Be glad and rejoice forever
in what I will create."

entries.title: Righteousness By Faith
entries.firstLine: Righteousness from God comes through faith

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Righteousness from God comes through faith
in Jesus Christ to all who believe.
There is no difference,
for all have sinned and fall short of
the glory of God,
and are justified freely by his grace
through the redemption that came
by Christ Jesus.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: God presented him as a sacrifice of atonement,
through faith in his blood.
He did this to demonstrate his justice,
because in his forbearance he had
left the sins committed beforehand unpunished

parts.speaker: leader
lines: he did it to demonstrate his justice at
the present time, so as to be just
and the one who justifies
the man who has faith in Jesus.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Therefore, there is now no condemnation
for those who are in Christ Jesus,
because through Christ Jesus
the law of the Spirit of life set me
free from the law of sin and death.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: What, then, shall we say in response to this?
If God is for us, who can be against us?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He who did not spare his own Son,
but gave him up for us allhow will he not also,
along with him,
graciously give us all things?
Who will bring any charge against those

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Who will bring any charge against those
whom God has chosen?
It is God who justifies.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: It is because of him
that you are in Christ Jesus,
who has become for us wisdom from God
that is, our righteousness,
holiness and redemption.

entries.title: Justification
entries.firstLine: and was raised to life for our justification.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: and was raised to life for our justification.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Therefore, since we have been justified through faith,
we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ,
through whom we have gained access by faith
into this grace in which we now stand.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And we rejoice in the hope of the glory of God.
Not only so, but we also rejoice in our sufferings,
because we know that suffering produces perseverance;
perseverance, character; and character, hope.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And hope does not disappoint us,
because God has poured out his love
into our hearts by the Holy Spirit,
whom he has given us.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You see, at just the right time,
when we were still powerless,
Christ died for the ungodly.
Very rarely will anyone die for a righteous man,
though for a good man someone
might possibly dare to die.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But God demonstrates his own love for us in this:
While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.
Since we have now been justified by his blood,
how much more shall we be saved
from God's wrath through him!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For if, when we were God's enemies,
we were reconciled to him through the death of his Son,
how much more, having been reconciled,
shall we be saved through his life!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Not only is this so,
but we also rejoice in God through
our Lord Jesus Christ,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: through whom we have now
received reconciliation.

entries.title: Sanctification
entries.firstLine: 1 Corinthians 6, Hebrews 2, and Titus 3 NJV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: 1 Corinthians 6, Hebrews 2, and Titus 3 NJV
Do you not know that the wicked will
not inherit the kingdom of God?
Do not be deceived:

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Neither the sexually immoral nor idolaters
nor adulterers nor male prostitutes
nor homosexual offenders nor thieves
nor the greedy nor drunkards nor slanderers
nor swindlers will inherit the kingdom of God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And that is what some of you were.
But you were washed, you were sanctified,
You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus Christ
and by the Spirit of our God.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Both the one who makes men holy and those who are
made holy are of the same family.
So Jesus is not ashamed to call them brothers.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Remind the people to be subject to rulers
and authorities, to be obedient,
to be ready to do whatever is good,
to slander no one,
to be peaceable and considerate,
and to show true humility toward all men.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: At one time we too were foolish, disobedient,
deceived and enslaved by all kinds of passions
and pleasures.
We lived in malice and envy,
being hated and hating one another.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: But when the kindness and love of God our Savior
'appeared, he saved us, not because of
righteous things we had done,
but because of his mercy.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He saved us through the washing of rebirth
and renewal by the Holy Spirit,
whom he poured out on us generously
through Jesus Christ our Savior, so that,
having been justified by his grace,
we might become heirs
having the hope of eternal life.

entries.title: Reconciliation
entries.firstLine: We are ruled by the love of Christ,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: We are ruled by the love of Christ,
now that we recognize that one man died for everyone,
which means that they all share in his death.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He died for all, so that those who live
should no longer live for themselves,
but only for him who died and was
raised to life for their sake.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: No longer, then, do we judge anyone
by human standards.
Even if at one time we judged Christ
according to human standards,
we no longer do so.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: When anyone is joined to Christ,
he is a new being; the old is gone,
the new has come.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: All this is done by God,
who through Christ changed us
from enemies into his friends and gave
us the task of making others his friends also.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Our message is that God was making
all mankind his friends through Christ.
God did not keep an account of their sins,
and he has given us the message which tells
how he makes them his friends.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Here we are, then, speaking for Christ,
as though God himself were making
his appeal through us.
We plead on Christ's behalf:
let God change you from enemies into his friends!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Christ was without sin,
but for our sake God made him share
our sin in order that in union with him
we might share the righteousness of God.

entries.title: Conversion
entries.firstLine: Time was when you were dead in

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Time was when you were dead in
your sins and wickedness,
when you followed the evil ways
of this present age,
when you obeyed the commander of
the spiritual powers of the air,
the spirit now at work among God's rebel subjects.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: We too were once of their number: we all
lived our lives in sensuality,
and obeyed the promptings of our
own instincts and notions.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: In our natural condition we, like the rest, ~
lay under the dreadful judgement of God.
But God, rich in mercy,
for the great love he bore us,
brought us to life with Christ
even when we were dead in our sins;
it is by his grace you are saved.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And in union with Christ Jesus he raised us up
and enthroned us with him in the heavenly realms,
so that he might display in the ages to come
how immense are the resources of his grace,
and how great his kindness to us in Christ Jesus.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For it is by his grace you are saved,
through trusting him;
it is not your own doing.
It is God's gift,
not a reward for work done.
There is nothing for anyone to boast of.
For we are God's handiwork,
created in Christ Jesus to devote ourselves
to the good deeds for which God has designed us.

entries.title: The Great Controversy
entries.firstLine: Now war arose in heaven,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Now war arose in heaven,
Michael and his angels
fighting against the dragon;
and the dragon and his angels fought,
but they were defeated and there was no
longer any place for them in heaven.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And the great dragon was thrown down,
that ancient serpent, who is called
the Devil and Satan,
the deceiver of the whole world
he was thrown down to the earth,
and his angels were thrown down with him.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying,
"Now the salvation and the power and
the kingdom of our God and the authority of
his Christ have come,
for the accuser of our brethren has
been thrown down,
who accuses them day and night
before our God.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "And they have conquered him by the blood
of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony,
for they loved not their lives even unto death.
"Rejoice then, O heaven and you that dwell therein!
But woe to you, O earth and sea,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: for the devil has come down to you in great wrath,
because he knows that his time is short!"

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And there were loud voices in heaven, saying
"The kingdom of the world bas become
the kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ,
and be shall reign for ever and ever."
SALVATION AND REDEMPTION: See also Nos.

entries.title: The Body of Christ
entries.firstLine: Just as each of us has one body with many members,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Just as each of us has one body with many members,
and these members do not all have the same function,
So in Christ we who are many form one body,
and each member belongs to all the others.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: We were all baptized by one Spirit into one body
wbether Jews or Greeks, slave or free
and we were all given the one Spirit to drink.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Now the body is not made up of one part but of many....
In fact God has arranged the parts in the body,
everyone of them, just as he wanted them to be.
If they were all one part, where would the body be?
As it is, there are many parts, but one body.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The eye cannot say to the band, "I don't need you!"
And the bead cannot say to the feet,
"I don't need you!"
On the contrary, those parts of the
body that seem to be weak, are indispensable

parts.speaker: leader
lines: There should be no division in the body, but...
its parts should have equal concern for each other.
If one part suffers, every part suffers with it;
if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Now you are the body of Cbrist,
and each one of you is a part of it.
COMMUNITY IN CHRIST: See also No.

entries.title: Mission of the Church
entries.firstLine: You are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You are a chosen generation, a royal priesthood,
a holy nation, His own special people,
that you may proclaim the praises
of Him who called you out of darkness
into His marvelous light.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For the grace of God that brings salvation
has appeared to all men, teaching us that,
denying ungodliness and worldly lusts,
we should live soberly, righteously,
and godly in the present age,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: looking for the blessed hope and glorious
appearing of our great God and
Savior Jesus Christ,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: who gave Himself for us,
that He might redeem us from every lawless deed
and purify for Himself His own special people,
zealous for good works.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Go therefore and make disciples of all the nations,
baptizing them in the name of the
Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
teaching them to observe all things
that I have commanded you;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "and lo, I am with you always,
even to the end of the age." Amen.
MISSION OF THE CHURCH: See also Nos.

entries.title: The Sabbath-I
entries.firstLine: Thus the heavens and the earth,
entries.scriptureRef: Genesis 2, Colossians 1, Nehemiah 9, Exodus 20, and Mark 2, NKJV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Thus the heavens and the earth,
and all the host of them, were finished.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And on the seventh day God ended His work
which He had done,
and He rested on the seventh day
from all His work which He had done.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Then God blessed the seventh day
and sanctified it,
because in it He rested from all His work
which God had created and made.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: By [Christ] all things were created
that are in heaven and that are on earth,
visible and invisible, whether thrones
or dominions or principalities or powers.
All things were created through Him and for Him.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You alone are the Lord;
You have made heaven,
The heaven of heavens,
with all their host,
The earth and all things on it,
The seas and all that is in them,
And You preserve them all.
The host of heaven worships You....
You made known to them Your holy Sabbath.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.
Six days you shall labor and do all your work,
but the seventh day is the Sabbath
of the Lord your God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "In it you shall do no work:
you, nor your son, nor your daughter,
nor your manservant, nor your maidservant,
nor your cattle, nor your stranger
who is within your gates.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "For in six days the Lord made the
heavens and the earth, the sea,
and all that is in them,
and rested the seventh day.
Therefore the Lord blessed the
Sabbath day and hallowed it."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "The Sabbath was made for man,
and not man for the Sabbath.
Therefore the Son of Man is also
Lord of the Sabbath."

entries.title: The Sabbath-2
entries.firstLine: "Keep my Sabbaths holy,
entries.scriptureRef: Ezekiel 20, Exodus 31, Isaiah 66, 58, Luke 4, and Matthew 12, NJV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Keep my Sabbaths holy,
that they may be a sign between us.
Then you will know that I am the Lord your God."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "'[The Sabbath] will be a sign between me
and the Israelites forever,
for in six days the Lord made the
heavens and the earth, and on the seventh
Play he abstained from work and rested.'"

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "As the new heavens and the new earth
that I make will endure before me,"
declares the Lord,
"so will your name and descendants endure.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "From one New Moon to another and
from one Sabbath to another,
all mankind will come and bow
down before me," says the Lord.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "If you keep your feet from breaking the Sabbath
and from doing as you please on my holy day,
if you call the Sabbath a delight and
the Lord's holy day honorable,
and if you honor it by not going your own way
and not doing as you please or speaking idle words,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "then you will Lind your joy in the Lord,
and I will cause you to ride on the
heights of the land and to feast on the
inheritance of your father Jacob."
The mouth of the Lord has spoken.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: where he had been brought up,
and on the Sabbath day he went into the synagogue,
as was his custom.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He said to them, *
"If any of you has a sheep
and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath,
will you not take hold of it and lift it out?
How much more valuable is a man than a sheep!
Therefore it is lawful to do good in the Sabbath!"

parts.speaker: leader
lines: * This is a different occasion from that described in the previous verse.

entries.title: Living Bread
entries.firstLine: Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Jesus said to them, "I am the bread of life.
Whoever comes to me shall never be hungry,
and whoever believes in me shall never be thirsty.
But you, as I said, do not believe
although you have seen.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "All that the Father gives me will come to me,
and the man who comes to me I will never turn away.
I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will,
but the will of him who sent me.
It is his will that I should not lose
even one of all that he has given me,
but raise them all up on the last day.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "For it is my Father's will that everyone
who looks upon the Son and puts his
faith in him shall possess eternal life;
and I will raise him up on the last day."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "In truth, in very truth I tell you,
the believer possesses eternal life.
I am the bread of life.
Your forefathers ate the manna in
the desert and they are dead.
I am speaking of the bread that
comes down from heaven,
which a man may eat, and never die.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "I am that living bread which has
come down from heaven;
if anyone eats this bread he shall live for ever.
Moreover, the bread which I will
give is my own flesh;
I give it for the life of the world."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: This led to a fierce dispute among the Jews.
"How can this man give us his
flesh to eat?" they said.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Jesus replied, "In truth, in very truth I tell you,
unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and
drink his blood you can have no life in you.
Whoever eats my flesh and drinks
my blood possesses eternal life,
and I will raise him up on the last day.
My flesh is real food; my blood is real drink.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood
dwells continually in me and I dwell in him.
As the living Father sent me,
and I live because of the Father,
so he who eats me shall live because of me.
This is the bread which came down from heaven;
and it is not like the bread which our fathers ate:
they are dead,
but whoever eats this bread shall live for ever."

entries.title: Memorial of Humility
entries.firstLine: Jesus knew that the time had come for him

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Jesus knew that the time had come for him
to leave this world and go to the Father.
Having loved his own who were in the world,
he now showed them the full extent of his love.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He got up from the meal,
took off his outer clothing,
and wrapped a towel around his waist.
After that, he poured water into a basin
and began to wash his disciples' feet,
drying them with the towel
that was wrapped around him.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him,
"Lord, are you going to wash my feet?"
Jesus replied, "You do not realize
now what I am doing,
but later you will understand."
"No," said Peter, "you shall never wash my feet."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Jesus answered, "Unless I wash you,
you have no part with me."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Then, Lord," Simon Peter replied,
"not just my feet but my hands and
my head as well!"

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Jesus answered,
"A person who has had a bath
needs only to wash his feet;
his whole body is clean."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: When he had finished washing their feet,
he put on his clothes and returned to his place.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Do you understand what I have
done for your" tie asked them.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "You call me 'Teacher' and 'Lord,'
and rightly so, for that is what I am.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Now that I, your Lord and Teacher,
have washed your feet,
you also should wash one
another's feet.
I have set you an example that you
should do as I have done for you."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Now that you know these things,
you will be blessed if you do them."

entries.title: The Lord's Supper
entries.firstLine: I received from the Lord

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I received from the Lord
that which I also delivered to you:

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: that the Lord Jesus on the same night
in which He was betrayed took bread:
and when He had given thanks,
He broke it and said,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Take, eat; this is My body
which is broken for you;
do this in remembrance of Me."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: In the same manner He also took the
cup after supper, saying,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "This cup is the new covenant in My blood.
This do, as often as you drink it,
in remembrance of Me."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For as often as you eat this bread
and drink this cup,
you proclaim the Lord's death till He comes.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Therefore whoever eats this bread
or drinks this cup of the Lord
in an unworthy manner will be
guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But let a man examine himself,
and so let him eat of that bread
and drink of that cup.
COMMUNION: See also Nos.

entries.title: The Law of the Lord Is Perfect
entries.firstLine: The law of the Lord is perfect,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The law of the Lord is perfect,
converting the soul;
The testimony of the Lord is sure,
making wise the simple;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The statutes of the Lord are right,
rejoicing the heart;
The commandment of the Lord is pure,
enlightening the eyes.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The fear of the Lord is clean,
enduring forever;
The judgments of the Lord are true
and righteous altogether.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: More to be desired are they than gold,
Yea, than much fine gold;
Sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
Moreover by them Your servant is warned,
And in keeping them there is great reward.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Who can understand his errors?
Cleanse me from secret faults.
Keep back Your servant also
from presumptuous sins;
Let them not have dominion over me.
Then I shall be blameless,
And I shall be innocent of great transgression.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Let the words of my mouth
and the meditation of my heart
Be acceptable in Your sight,
O Lord, my strength and my redeemer.

entries.title: The Ten Commandments
entries.firstLine: God spake all these words, saying,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: God spake all these words, saying,
I am the Lord thy God,
which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt,
out of the house of bondage.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image,
or any likeness of any thing
that is in heaven above,
or that is in the earth beneath,
or that is in the water under the earth:

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Thou shalt not bow down thyself to them,
nor serve them:
for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God,
visiting the iniquity of the fathers
upon the children unto the third and fourth
generation of them that hate me;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And shewing mercy unto thousands
of them that love me,
and keep my commandments.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Thou shalt not take the name
of the Lord thy God in vain:
for the Lord will not hold him guiltless
that taketh his name in vain.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy,
Six days shalt thou labour,
and do all thy work:

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: but the seventh day is the sabbath of
the Lord thy God:
in it thou shalt not do any work,
thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant,
nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle,
nor thy stranger that is within thy gates:

parts.speaker: leader
lines: for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth,
the sea, and all that in them is,
and rested the seventh day:

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: wherefore the Lord blessed the sabbath day,
and hallowed it.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Honour thy father and thy mother,
that thy days may be long upon the land
which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Thou shalt not kill.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Thou shalt not commit adultery.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Thou shalt not steal.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Thou shalt not bear false witness
against thy neighbour.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's house,
thou shalt not covet thy neighbour's wife,
nor his manservant, nor his maidservant,
nor his ox, nor his ass,
nor any thing that is thy neighbour's.
LAW AND GRACE: See also Nos.

entries.title: Gifts of the Spirit
entries.firstLine: Now about spiritual gifts, brothers,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Now about spiritual gifts, brothers,
I do not want you to be ignorant.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: There are different kinds of gifts,
but the same Spirit.
There are different kinds of service,
but the same Lord.
There are different kinds of working,
but the same God works all of them in all men.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Now to each one the manifestation of
the Spirit is given for the common good.
To one there is given through the
Spirit the message of wisdom,
to another the message of knowledge
by means of the same Spirit;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: to another faith by the same Spirit,
to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit,
to another miraculous powers,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: to another prophecy,
to another the ability to distinguish
between spirits,
to another the ability to speak
in different kinds of tongues,
and to still another
the interpretation of tongues.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: All these are the work of one
and the same Spirit,
and he gives them to each man,
just as he determines.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The body is a unit,
though it is made up of many parts;
and though all its parts are many,
they form one body.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: So it is with Christ.

entries.title: Christian Unity
entries.firstLine: As a prisoner for the Lord, then,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: As a prisoner for the Lord, then,
I urge you to live a life worthy of
the calling you have received.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Be completely humble and gentle; be patient,
bearing with one another in love.
Make every effort to keep the unity of
the Spirit through the bond of peace.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: There is one body and one Spirit,
just as you were called to one hope
when you were called,
one Lord, one faith, one baptism;
one God and Father of all,
who is over all and through all and in all.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But to each one of us grace has been
given as Christ apportioned it.
This is why it says:
"When he ascended on high,
he led captives in his train
and gave gifts to men."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: It was he who gave some to be apostles,
some to be prophets, some to be evangelists,
and some to be pastors and teachers,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: To prepare God's people
for works of service,
so that the body of Christ may
be built up until we all reach unity
in the faith and in the knowledge of the
Son of God and become mature,
attaining to the whole measure
of the fullness of Christ.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Then we will no longer be infants,
tossed back and forth by the waves,
and blown here and there
by every wind of teaching and by
the cunning and craftiness of
men in their deceitful scheming.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Instead, speaking the truth in love,
we will in all things grow up into
him who is the Head, that is, Christ.
From him the whole body,
joined and held together
by every supporting ligament,
grows and builds itself up in love,
as each part does its work.
SPIRITUAL GIFTS: See also Nos.

entries.title: Our Atoning Judge
entries.firstLine: Why do you judge your brother?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Why do you judge your brother?
Or why do you look down on your brother?
For we will all stand before God's
judgment seat.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: It is written:
"'As surely as I live,' says the Lord,
'Every knee will bow before me;
every tongue will confess to God.'"

parts.speaker: leader
lines: So then, each of us will give an
account of himself to God.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: My dear children, I write this to you
so that you will not sin.
But if anybody does sin,
we have one who speaks to the Father
in our defense, Jesus Christ,
the Righteous One.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins,
and not only for ours but also for
the sins of the whole world.

entries.title: Day of Judgment
entries.firstLine: "Thrones were set in place

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Thrones were set in place
and one of great age took his seat.
His robe was white as snow,
the hair of his head as pure as wool.
His throne was a blaze of flames,
its wheels were a burning fire.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "A stream of fire poured out,
issuing from his presence.
A thousand thousand waited on him,
ten thousand times ten thousand
stood before him.
A court was held and the books were opened."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I saw the dead, both great and small,
standing in front of his throne,
while the book of life was opened,
and other books opened which were the record
of what they had done in their lives,
by which the dead were judged.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Then I saw a new heaven and a new earth;
the first heaven and the first earth
had disappeared now,
and there was no longer any sea.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I saw the holy city, and the new Jerusalem,
coming down from God out of heaven
as beautiful as a bride all dressed for her husband.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Here God lives among men.
He will make his home among them;
they shall be his people,
and he will be their God;
his name is God-with-them."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Very soon now, I shall be with you again,
bringing the reward to be given
to every man according to what he deserves."

entries.title: The Three Angels' Messages
entries.firstLine: I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I saw another angel fly in the midst of heaven,
having the everlasting gospel
to preach unto them that dwell on the earth,
and to every nation, and kindred, and tongue,
and people, saying with a loud voice,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Fear God, and give glory to him;
for the hour of his judgment is come:
and worship him that made heaven, and earth,
and the sea, and the fountains of waters.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And there followed another angel,
saying, Babylon is fallen, is fallen,
that great city,
because she made all nations drink of the wine
of the wrath of her fornication.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And the third angel followed them,
saying with a loud voice,
If any man worship the beast and his image,
and receive his mark in his forehead,
or in his hand,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: the same shall drink of the wine
of the wrath of God,
which is poured out without mixture
into the cup of his indignation;
and he shall be tormented with fire and brimstone
in the presence of the holy angels,
and in the presence of the Lamb:

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: and the smoke of their torment
ascendeth up for ever and ever:
and they have no rest day nor night,
who worship the beast and of his image,
and whosoever receiveth the mark of his name.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Here is the patience of the saints:
here are they that keep the commandments of God,
and the faith of Jesus.
JUDGMENT: See also Nos.

entries.title: The Resurrection of God's People
entries.firstLine: To this end Christ died and lived again,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: To this end Christ died and lived again,
that he might be Lord
both of the dead and of the living.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: If for this life only
we have hoped in Christ,
we are of all men most to be pitied.
But in fact Christ has been raised
from the dead, the first fruits of those
who have fallen asleep.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For as by a man came death,
by a man has come also
the resurrection of the dead.
For as in Adam all die,
so also in Christ shall all be made alive.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For this we declare to you by the word of the Lord,
that we who are alive,
who are left until the coming of the Lord,
shall not precede those who have fallen asleep.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For the Lord himself will descend
from heaven with a cry of command,
with the archangel's call,
and with the sound of the trumpet of God.
And the dead in Christ will rise first;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: then we who are alive, who are left,
shall be caught up together with them
in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air;
and so we shall always be with the Lord.
Therefore comfort one another with these words.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Lo! I tell you a mystery.
We shall not all sleep,
but we shall all be changed,
in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye,
at the last trumpet.
For the trumpet will sound,
and the dead will be raised in perishable,
and we shall be changed.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Thanks be to God,
who gives us the victory
through our Lord Jesus Christ.
RESURRECTION OF THE SAINTS: See also No.

entries.title: Assurance of Eternal Life
entries.firstLine: "Yes, God loved the world so much

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Yes, God loved the world so much
that he gave his only Son,
so that everyone who believes in him
may not be lost but may have eternal life.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "For God sent his Son into the world
not to condemn the world,
but so that through him
the world might be saved."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "The sheep that belong to me listen to my voice;
I know them and they follow me.
I give them eternal life;
they will never be lost
and no one will steal them from me.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "The Father who gave them to me
is greater than anyone,
and no one can steal from the Father.
The Father and I are one."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: This is the testimony:
God has given us eternal life
and this life is in his Son;
anyone who has the Son has life,
anyone who does not have the Son
does not have life.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: I have written all this to you so that you
who believe in the name of the Son of God
may be sure that you have eternal life.

entries.title: A New Heaven and a New Earth
entries.firstLine: I saw a new heaven and a new earth,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I saw a new heaven and a new earth,
for the first heaven and the first
earth had passed away.
Also there was no more sea.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Then I, John, saw the holy city, New Jerusalem,
coming down out of heaven from God,
prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And I heard a loud voice from heaven saying,
"Behold, the tabernacle of God is with men,
and He will dwell with them,
and they shall be His people,
and God Himself will be with them and be their God.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes;
there shall be no more death, nor sorrow, nor crying;
and there shall be no more pain, for the former
things have passed away."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Then He who sat on the throne said,
"Behold, I make all things new." And He said to me,
"Write, for these words are true and faithful."*
* May be combined with No.
ETERNAL LIFE: See also Nos.

entries.title: Blessed Is the Man
entries.firstLine: Blessed is the man who walks not

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Blessed is the man who walks not
in the counsel of the wicked,
nor stands in the way of sinners,
nor sits in the seat of scoffers;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: but his delight is in the law of the Lord,
and on his law he meditates day and night.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He is like a tree planted by streams of water,
that yields its fruit in its season,
and its leaf does not wither.
In all that he does, he prospers.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The wicked are not so,
but are like chaff which the wind drives away.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment,
nor sinners in the congn~galion or the righteous;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: for the Lord knows the way of the righteous,
but the way of the wicked will perish.

entries.title: The Earth Is the Lord's
entries.firstLine: The earth is the Lord's

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The earth is the Lord's
and the fulness thereof,
the world and those who dwell therein;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: for He has founded it upon the seas,
and established it upon the rivers.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Who shall ascend the hill of the Lord?
And who shall stand in his holy place?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He who has clean hands and a pure heart,
who does not lift up his soul
to what is false,
and does not swear deceitfully.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He will receive blessing from the Lord,
and vindication from the God of his salvation.
Such is the generation of those who seek him,
who Seek the face of the God of Jacob.
Lift up your heads, O gates! and be lifted up,
O ancient doors! that the King of glory may come in.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Who is the King of glory?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The Lord, strong and mighty,
the Lord, mighty ill battle!
Lift up your heads, O gates!
and be lifted up, O ancient doors!
that the King of glory may come in,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Who is this King of glory?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory!

entries.title: The New Life
entries.firstLine: What shall we say, then?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: What shall we say, then?
Should we continue to live in sin
so that God's grace will increase?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Certainly not! We have died to sin,
how then can we go on living in it?
For when a person dies,
he is set free from the power of sin.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Since we have died with Christ,
we believe that we will also live with him.
For we know that Christ has been raised
from death and will never die again
death will no longer rule over him.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And so, because he died,
sin has no power over him;
and now he lives his life in fellowship with God.
In the same way you are to think of yourselves
as dead, so far as sin is concerned,
but living in fellowship
with God through Christ Jesus.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Sin must no longer rule in your mortal bodies,
so that you obey the desires of your natural self.
Nor must you surrender any part of yourselves
to sin to be used for wicked purposes.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Instead, give yourselves to God,
as those who have been brought from death to life,
and surrender your whole being to him
to be used for righteous purposes.
Sin must not be your master;
for you do not live under law but under God's grace.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: What, then? Shall we sin,
because we are not under law
but under God's grace? By no means!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Now you have been set free from
sin and are the slaves of God.
Your gain is a life fully dedicated to him,
and the result is eternal life.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For sin pays its wage, death;
but God's free gift is eternal life
in union with Christ Jesus our Lord.

entries.title: Christianity in Practice
entries.firstLine: Let love be genuine; hate what is evil,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Let love be genuine; hate what is evil,
hold fast to what is good;
love one another with brotherly affection;
outdo one another in showing honor.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Never Bag in zeal, but aglow with the Spirit,
serve the Lord.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Rejoice in your hope, be patient
in tribulation, be constant in prayer.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Contribute to the needs of the saints,
practice hospitality.
Bless those who persecute you;
bless and do not curse them.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Rejoice with those who rejoice,
weep with those who weep.
Live in harmony with one another;
do not be haughty,
but associate with the lowly;
never be conceited.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Repay no one evil for evil,
but take thought for what is noble in
the sight of all.
If possible, so far as it depends upon you,
live peaceably with all.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Beloved, never avenge yourselves,
but leave it to the wrath of God;
for it is written,
"Vengeance is mine, I 'will repay,
says the Lord."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: No, "if your enemy is hungry, feed him;
if he is thirsty, give him drink;
for by so doing you will heap burning coals
upon his head."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Do not be overcome by evil,
but overcome evil with good.

entries.title: Love
entries.firstLine: Though I speak with the tongues of men

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Though I speak with the tongues of men
and of angels, but have not love,
I have become as sounding brass
or a clanging cymbal.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And though I have the gift of prophecy,
and understand all mysteries
and all knowledge,
and though I have all faith,
so that I could remove mountains,
but have not love, I am nothing.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And though I bestow all my goods
to feed the poor,
and though I give my body to be burned,
but have not love, it profits me nothing.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Love suffers long and is kind; love does not envy;
love does not parade itself, is not puffed up;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: does not behave rudely, does not seek its own,
is not provoked, thinks no evil;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: does not rejoice in iniquity,
but rejoices in the truth; bears all things,
believes all things, hopes all things,
endures all things.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Love never fails.
But whether there are prophecies,
they will fail;
whether there are tongues,
they will cease;
whether there is knowledge,
it will vanish away.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For we know in part and we prophesy in part.
But when that which is perfect has come,
then that which is in part will be done away.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: When I was a child,
I spoke as a child,
I understood as a child,
I thought as a child;
but when I became a man,
I put away childish things.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For now we see in a mirror, dimly,
but then face to face.
Now I know in part,
but then I shall know just as I also am known.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And now abide faith, hope, love, these three;
but the greatest of these is love.
(A New Testament canticle.)

entries.title: Growing in Christ (Sanctification)
entries.firstLine: Since you have been brought back to

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Since you have been brought back to
true life with Christ,
you must look for the things
that are in heaven, where Christ is,
sitting at God's right hand.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Let your thoughts be on heavenly things,
not on the things that are on the earth,
because you have died,
and now the life you have is hidden with Christ in God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: But when Christ is revealed and he is your life
you too will be revealed
in all your glory with him.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: That is why you must kill everything in you
that belongs only to earthly life:
fornication, impurity, guilty passion,
evil desires and especially greed,
which is the same thing as worshipping a false god;
all this is the
sort of behaviour that makes God angry.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And it is the way in which you used to live
when you were surrounded by
people doing the same thing,
but now you, of all people,
must give all these things up:
getting angry, being bad-tempered, spitefulness,
abusive language and dirty talk;
and never tell each other lies.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: You have stripped off your old
behaviour with your old self,
and you have put on a new self which will
progress towards true knowledge
the more it is renewed
in the image of its creator;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: and in that image there is no room
for distinction between Greek and Jew,
between the circumcised or the uncircumcised,
or between barbarian and Scythian, slave and free man.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: There is only Christ:
he is everything and he is in everything.*
*May bejoined with No.
for a longer passage.

entries.title: The Children of God
entries.firstLine: See what love the Father has given us,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: See what love the Father has given us,
that we should be called children of God;
and so we are. The reason why the world does not
know us is that it did not know him.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Beloved, we are God's children now;
it does not yet appear what we shall be,
but we know that when he appears we shall be like him,
for we shall see him as he is.
And every one who thus hopes in him
purifies himself as he is pure.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Every one who commits sin is guilty of lawlessness;
sin is lawlessness.
You know that he appeared to take away sins,
and in him there is no sin.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: No one who abides in him sins;
no one who sins has either seen him or known him.
Little children, let no one deceive you.
He who does right is righteous, as he is righteous.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He who commits sin is of the devil;
for the devil has sinned from the beginning.
The reason the Son of God appeared was to
destroy the works of the devil.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: No one born of God commits sin;
for God's nature abides in him,
and he cannot sin because he is born of God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: By this it may be seen who are the children of God,
and who are the children of the devil:
whoever does not do right is not of God,
nor he who does not love his brother.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For this is the message which you
have heard from the beginning,
that we should love one another.

entries.title: Set Your Mind On God's Kingdom
entries.firstLine: "No servant can be the slave of two masters;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "No servant can be the slave of two masters;
for either he will hate the first and love the second,
or he will be devoted to the first and
think nothing of the second.
You cannot serve God and Money.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Therefore I bid you put away anxious thoughts
about food and drink to keep you alive,
and clothes to cover your body.
Surely life is more than food,
the body more than clothes.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Look at the birds of the air;
they do not sow and reap and store in barns,
yet your heavenly Father feeds them.
You are worth more than the birds!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Is there a man of you who by anxious
thought can add a foot to his height?
And why be anxious about clothes?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Consider how the lilies grow in the fields;
they do not work, they do not spin; and yet,
I tell you, even Solomon in all his splendour
was not attired like one of these.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "But if that is how God clothes the
grass in the fields, which is there today,
and tomorrow is thrown on the stove,
will he not all the more clothe you?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "How little faith you have!
No, do not ask anxiously,
'What are we to eat? What are we to drink?
What shall we wear?'

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "All these are things for the heathen to run after,
not for you, because your heavenly Father
knows that you need them all.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Set your mind on God's kingdom and his
justice before every thing else,
and all the rest will come to you as well."

entries.title: The Path of Life
entries.firstLine: You, O Lord, are the portion of my

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You, O Lord, are the portion of my
inheritance and my cup;
You maintain my lot.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places;
Yes, I have a good inheritance.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I will bless the Lord who has given me counsel;
My heart also instructs me in the night seasons.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: I have set the Lord always before me;
Because He is at my right hand I shall not be moved.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Therefore my heart is glad, and my glory rejoices;
My flesh also will rest in hope.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For You will not leave my soul in Sheol,*
Nor will You allow Your Holy One to see corruption.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You will show me the path of life;
In Your presence is fullness of joy;
At Your right hand are pleasures forevermore.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The Grave

entries.title: Happy Are All Who Fear the Lord
entries.firstLine: Happy are all who fear the Lord,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Happy are all who fear the Lord,
who live according to his will.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: You shall eat the fruit of your own labours,
you shall be happy and you shall prosper.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Your wife shall be like a fruitful vine
in the heart of your house;
your sons

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: shall be like olive-shoots
round about your table.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: This is the blessing in store for the
man who fears the Lord.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: May the Lord bless you from Zion;
may you share the prosperity of Jerusalem
all the days of your life,
and live to see your children's children!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Peace be upon Israel!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Children in R.S.V. and other versions

entries.title: Wisdom
entries.firstLine: Happy the man who discovers wisdom,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Happy the man who discovers wisdom,
the man who gains discernment:

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: gaining her is more rewarding than silver,
more profitable than gold.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: She is beyond the price of pearls,
nothing you could covet is her equal.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: In her right hand is length of days;
in her left hand, riches and honour.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: In her ways arec delightful ways,
her paths all lead to contentment.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: She is a tree of life for those who hold her fast,
those who cling to her live happy lives.

entries.title: The Christian Life
entries.firstLine: "Blessed are the poor in spirit,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Blessed are the poor in spirit,
for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Blessed are those who mourn,
for they will be comforted.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Blessed are the meek,
for they will inherit the earth.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Blessed are those who hunger and
thirst for righteousness,
for they will be filled.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Blessed are the merciful,
for they will be shown mercy.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Blessed are the pure in heart,
for they will see God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Blessed are the peacemakers,
for they will be called sons of God.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Blessed are those who are persecuted
because of righteousness,
for theirs is the kingdom of heaven.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Blessed are you when people insult you,
persecute you and falsely say all kinds
of evil against you because of me.
Rejoice and be glad,
because great is your reward in heaven,
for in the same way they persecuted
the prophets who were before you.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "You are the salt of the earth.
But if the salt loses its saltiness,
how can it be made salty again?
It is no longer good for anything,
except to be thrown out and trampled by men.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "You are the light of the world.
A city on a hill cannot be hidden.
Neither do people light a lamp and put it under a bowl.
Instead they put it on its stand,
and it gives light to everyone in the house.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "In the same way,
let your light shine before men,
that they may see your good deeds
and praise your Father in heaven."
JOY AND PEACE: See also Nos.

entries.title: Hope and Comfort
entries.firstLine: Do not be afraid, for I am with you;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Do not be afraid, for I am with you;
stop being anxious and watchful,
for I am your God.
I give you strength, I bring you help,
I uphold you with my victorious right hand.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The eye of Yahweh is on those who fear him,
on those who rely on his love,
to rescue their souls from death
and keep them alive in famine.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: It is by faith and through Jesus that we have
entered this state of grace in which we
can boast about looking forward to God's glory.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But that is not all we can boast about;
we can boast about our sufferings.
These sufferings bring patience, as we know,
and patience brings perseverance,
and perseverance brings hope,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: and this hope is not deceptive,
because the love of God has been
poured into our hearts by the
Holy Spirit which has been given us.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: May the God of hope bring you such joy and peace
in your faith that the power of the Holy Spirit
will remove all bounds to hope.
HOPE AND COMFORT: See also Nos.

entries.title: Meditation
entries.firstLine: This book of the law

parts.speaker: leader
lines: This book of the law
shall not depart out of your mouth,
but you shall meditate on it day and night,
that you may be careful to do according
to all that is written in it;
for then you shall make your way prosperous,
and then you shall have good success.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: I have laid up thy word in my heart,
that I might not sin against thee....
I will meditate on thy precepts,
and fix my eyes on thy ways.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I will delight in thy statutes;
I will not forget thy word....
I revere thy commandments, which I love,
and I will meditate on thy statutes.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: I remember thy name in the night,
O Lord, and keep thy law....
Oh, how I love thy law!
It is my meditation all the day.

parts.speaker: leader
