lines: Thy commandment makes me wiser than my enemies,
for it is ever with me.
I have more understanding than all my teachers,
for thy testimonies are my meditation.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: I rise before dawn and cry for help;
I hope in thy words.
My eyes are awake before the watches of the night,
that I may meditate upon thy promise.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation
of my heart be acceptable in thy sight,
O Lord, my rock and my redeemer.

entries.title: Prayer
entries.firstLine: "When you pray, do not imitate the hypocrites:

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "When you pray, do not imitate the hypocrites:
they love to say their prayers standing up
in the synagogues and at the street corners
for people to see them.
I tell you solemnly, they have had their reward.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "But when you pray,
go to your private room and,
when you have shut your door,
pray to your Father who is in that secret place,
and your Father who sees all that is done
in secret will reward you.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "In your prayers do not babble as the pagans do,
for they think that by using many words
they will make themselves heard.
Do not be like them;
your Father knows what you need
before you ask him."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "If you forgive others their failings,
your heavenly Father will forgive you yours;
but if you do not forgive others,
your Father will not forgive your failings either."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Ask, and it will be given to you;
search, and you will find;
knock, and the door will be opened to you.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "For the one who asks always receives;
the one who searches always finds;
the one who knocks will always
have the door opened to him.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Is there a man among you who would hand his son
a stone when he asked for bread?
Or would hand him a snake when he asked for a fish?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "If you, then, who are evil,
know how to give your children what is good,
how much more will your Father in heaven
give good things to those who ask him!"
(The Lord's Prayer is No.
MEDITATION AND PRAYER: See also Nos.

entries.title: Do Not Worry
entries.firstLine: Do not worry about the wicked,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Do not worry about the wicked,
do not envy those who do wrong.
Quick as the grass they wither,
fading like the green in the field.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Trust in Yahweh and do what is good,
make your home in the land and live in peace;
make Yahweh your only joy and he will give you
what your heart desires.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Commit your fate to Yahweh,
trust in him and he will act:
making your virtue clear as the light,
your integrity as bright as noon.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Be quiet before Yahweh,
and wait patiently for him,
not worrying about men who make their fortunes,
about men who scheme to bring
the poor and needy down.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Enough of anger, leave rage aside,
do not worry, nothing but evil can come of it:
for the wicked will be expelled,
while those who hope in Yahweh
shall have the land for their own.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: A little longer, and the wicked will be no more,
search his place well, he will not be there:
but the humble shall have the land for their own
to enjoy untroubled peace.

entries.title: Union with Christ
entries.firstLine: "I am the true vine,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "I am the true vine,
and My Father is the vinedresser.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Every branch in Me that does not bear fruit,
He takes away;
and every branch that bears fruit,
He prunes it, that it may bear more fruit.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "You are already clean because of
the word which I have spoken to you.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Abide in Me, and I in you.
As the branch cannot bear fruit of itself,
unless it abides in the vine,
so neither can you,
unless you abide in Me.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "I am the vine, you are the branches;
he who abides in Me, and I in him,
he bears much fruit;
for apart from Me you can do nothing.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "If anyone does not abide in Me,
he is thrown away as a branch, and dries up;
and they gather them,
and cast them into the fire,
and they are burned.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "If you abide in Me,
and My words abide in you,
ask whatever you wish,
and it shall be done for you.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "By this is My Father glorified,
that you bear much fruit,
and so prove to be My disciples.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Just as the Father has loved Me,
I have also loved you; abide in My love.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "If you keep My commandments,
you will abide in My love;
just as I have kept My Father's commandments,
and abide in His love."
FAITH AND TRUST: See also No.

entries.title: I Waited Patiently for the Lord
entries.firstLine: I waited patiently for the Lord;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I waited patiently for the Lord;
he turned to me and heard my cry.
He lifted me out of the slimy pit,
out of the mud and mire;
he set my feet on a rock and gave me
a firm place to stand.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He put a new song in my mouth,
a hymn of praise to our God.
Many will see and fear and put their
trust in the Lord.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Blessed is the man who makes the Lord his trust,
who does not look to the proud,
to those who turn aside to false gods.
Many, O Lord my God,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: are the wonders you have done.
The things you planned for us
no one can recount to you;
were I to speak and tell of them,
they would be too many to declare.
"To do your will, O my God, is my desire;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: your law is within my heart."...
I do not hide your righteousness in my heart;
I speak of your faithfulness and salvation.
I do not conceal your love and your truth
from the great assembly.
Do not withhold your mercy from me, O Lord;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: may your love and your truth always protect me.

entries.title: Guidance
entries.firstLine: Blessed are those whose way is blameless,
entries.scriptureRef: Psalms 119, 25, Isaiah 30, Psalm 32, and John 16, RSV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Blessed are those whose way is blameless,
who walk in the law of the Lord!
Blessed are those who keep his testimonies,
who seek him with their whole heart.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Put false ways far from me;
and graciously teach me thy law!
I have chosen the way of faithfulness,
I set thy ordinances before me.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Lead me in the path of thy commandments,
for I delight in it....
Turn my eyes from looking at vanities;
and give me life in thy ways.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Thy word is a lamp to my feet
and a light to my path.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Good and upright is the Lord;
therefore he instructs sinners in the way.
He leads the humble in what is right,
and teaches the humble his way.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: All the paths of the Lord are
steadfast love and faithfulness,
for those who keep his covenant and
his testimonies.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Your ears shall hear a word behind you,
saying, "This is the way, walk in it,"
when you turn to the right or when
you turn to the left.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: I will instruct you and teach you the
way you should go;
I will counsel you with my eye upon you.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "When the Spirit of truth comes,
he will guide you into all the truth;
for he will not speak on his own authority,
but whatever he hears he will speak,
and he will declare to you
the things that are to come."
GUIDANCE: See also Nos.

entries.title: Praise Is Rightfully Yours
entries.firstLine: Praise is rightfully yours, God, in Zion.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Praise is rightfully yours, God, in Zion.
Vows to you must be fulfilled,
for you answer prayer.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: All flesh must come to you with all its sins;
though our faults overpower us,
you blot them out.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Happy the man you choose, whom
you invite to live in your courts.
Fill us with the good things of your house,
of your holy Temple.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Your righteousness repays us with marvels,
God our saviour, hope of all the ends of
the earth and the distant islands.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Your strength holds the mountains up,
such is the power that wraps you;
you calm the clamour of the ocean,
the clamour of its waves.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The nations are un uproar,
in panic those who live at the ends of the world,
as your miracles bring shouts of joy
to the portals of morning and evening.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You visit the earth and water it,
you load it with riches;
God's rivers brim with water
to provide their grain.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: This is how you provide it:
by drenching its furrows,
by levelling its ridges,
by softening it with showers,
by blessing the first-fruits.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You crown the year with your bounty,
abundance flows wherever you pass;
the desert pastures overflow,
the hillsides are wrapped in joy,
the meadows are dressed in flocks,
the valleys are clothed in wheat,
what shouts of joy, what singing!
THANKFULNESS: See also Nos.

entries.title: A Prayer of Confession
entries.firstLine: "Lord God, you are great, and we honor you.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Lord God, you are great, and we honor you.
You are faithful to your covenant and show constant love
to those who love you and do what you command.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "We have sinned, we have been evil, we have done wrong.
We have rejected what you commanded us to do
and have turned away from what you showed us was right.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "We have not listened to your servants the prophets,
who spoke in your name to our kings, our rulers,
our ancestors, and our whole nation.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "You, Lord, always do what is right,
but we have always brought dis grace on ourselves....
You are merciful and forgiving,
although we have rebelled against you.
"We did not listen to you, O Lord our God,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: when you told us to live according to the laws
which you gave us through your servants the prophets....
You did what you said you would do to us and our rulers....
O Lord our God, we have not tried to please you
by turning from our sins or by following your truth."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "0 Lord our God, you showed your power
by bringing your people out of Egypt,
and your power is still remembered.
We have sinned; we have done wrong."
"Listen to us, O God; look at us and see

parts.speaker: leader
lines: the trouble we are in and the suffering
of the city that bears your name.
We are praying to you because you are merciful,
not because we have done right.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Lord, hear us. Lord, forgive us.
Lord, listen to us, and act!
In order that everyone will know that you are God,
do not delay! This city and these people are yours."

entries.title: Humility
entries.firstLine: If you have any encouragement

parts.speaker: leader
lines: If you have any encouragement
from being united with Christ,
if any comfort from his love,
if any fellowship with the Spirit,
if any tenderness and compassion,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: then make my joy complete by being like-minded,
having the same love,
being one in spirit and purpose.
Do nothing out of selfish ambition or vain conceit,
but in humility consider others better than yourselves.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Each of you should look not only to your own interests,
but also to the interests of others.
Your attitude should be the same as that of Christ Jesus:
Who, being in very nature God,
...made himself nothing.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And being found in appearance as a man,
he humbled himself and became obedient
to death even death on a cross!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Therefore, my dear friends,...
continue to work out your salvation
with fear and trembling,
for it is God who works in you to will
and to act according to his good purpose.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Do everything without complaining or arguing,
so that you may become blameless and pure,
children of God without fault in
a crooked and depraved generation,
in which you shine like stars in the universe.
Philippians 2:6-11 is No.

entries.title: Arise, Shine
entries.firstLine: Arise, shine out, for your light has come,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Arise, shine out, for your light has come,
the glory of Yahweh is rising on you,
though night still covers the earth
and darkness the peoples.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Above you Yahweh now rises and
above you his glory appears.
The nations come to your light
and kings to your dawning brightness.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Lift up your eyes and look round:
all are assembling and coming towards you,
your sons from far away and your daughters
being tenderly carried.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: At this sight you will grow radiant,
your heart throbbing and full; since the:
riches of the sea will flow to you,
the wealth of the nations come to you.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Though you have been abandoned,
and hated and shunned,
I will make you an eternal pride,
a joy for ever and ever.

entries.title: The Lord's Work
entries.firstLine: The Spirit of the Sovereign Lord is on me,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The Spirit of the Sovereign Lord is on me,
because the Lord has anointed me
to preach good news to the poor.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He has sent me to bind up the brokenhearted,
to proclaim freedom for the captives
and release for the prisoners,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: to proclaim the year of the Lord's favor
and the day of vengeance of our God,
to comfort all who mourn,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: and provide for those who grieve in Zion
to bestow on them a crown of beauty
instead of ashes, the oil of gladness
instead of mourning,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: and a garment of praise instead of a spirit of despair.
They will be called oaks of righteousness,
a planting of the Lord
for the display of his splendor.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: I delight greatly in the Lord;
my soul rejoices in my God.
For he has clothed me with garments of salvation
and arrayed me in a robe of righteousness,
as a bridegroom adorns his head like a priest,
and as a bride adorns herself with her jewels.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For as the soil makes the sprout come up
and a garden causes seeds to grow,
so the Sovereign Lord will make righteousness
and praise spring up before all nations.

entries.title: Doing Good to All
entries.firstLine: Brothers, if someone is caught in a sin,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Brothers, if someone is caught in a sin,
you who are spiritual should restore him gently.
But watch yourself, or you also may be tempted.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Carry each other's burdens, and in this way
you will fulfill the law of Christ.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: If anyone thinks he is something when he is nothing,
he deceives himself.
Each one should test his own actions.
Then he can take pride in himself,
without comparing himself to some body else,
for each one should carry his own load.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Anyone who receives instruction in the word
must share all good things with his instructor.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Do not be deceived:
God cannot be mocked.
A man reaps what he sows.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The one who sows to please his sinful nature,
from that nature will reap destruction;
the one who sows to please the Spirit,
from the Spirit will reap eternal life.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Let us not become weary in doing good,
for at the proper time we will reap a
harvest if we do not give up.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Therefore, as we have opportunity,
let us do good to all people,
especially to those who belong
to the family of believers.

entries.title: Christian Duties
entries.firstLine: Now we ask you, brothers,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Now we ask you, brothers,
to respect those who work hard among you,
who are over you in the Lord and who admonish you.
Hold them in the highest regard in
love because of their work.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Live in peace with each other.
And we urge you, brothers,
warn those who are idle,
encourage the timid, help the weak,
be patient with everyone.
Make sure that nobody pays back wrong for wrong,
but always try to be kind to each
other and to everyone else.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Be joyful always; pray continually;
give thanks in all circumstances,
for this is God's will for you in Christ Jesus.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Do not put out the Spirit's fire;
do not treat prophecies with contempt.
Test everything. Hold on to the good.
A void every kind of evil.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: May God himself, the God of peace,
sanctify you through and through.
May your whole spirit,
soul and body be kept blameless at
the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Work and Duty
entries.firstLine: Let our people learn to apply them
entries.scriptureRef: Titus 3, 1 Timothy 6, 2 Corinthians 5, and Ecclesiastes 12, RSV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Let our people learn to apply them
selves to good deeds,
so as to help cases of urgent need,
and not to be unfruitful.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: They are to do good,
to be rich in good deeds,
liberal and generous,
thus laying up for themselves a
good foundation for the future,
so that they may take hold of the life
which is life indeed.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I desire you to insist on these things,
so that those who have believe in God may
be careful to apply themselves to good deeds;
these are excellent and profitable to men.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: We must all appear before the
judgment seat of Christ,
so that each one may receive good or evil,
according to what he has done in the body.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Fear God, and keep his commandments;
for this is the whole duty of man.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For God will bring every deed into judgment,
with every secret thing, whether good or evil.
LOVING SERVICE: See also Nos.

entries.title: Peace
entries.firstLine: How wonderful it is, how pleasant,
entries.scriptureRef: Psalm 133, 1 Corinthians 1, Romans 14, James 3, and 2 Corinthians 13, TEV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: How wonderful it is, how pleasant,
for God's people to live together in harmony!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: By the authority of our Lord Jesus Christ
I appeal to all of you, my brothers,
to agree in what you say,
so that there will be no divisions among you.
Be completely united, with only one thought
and one purpose.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: So then, we must always aim at those
things that bring peace
and I that help strengthen one another.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The wisdom from above is pure first of all;
it is also peaceful, gentle, and friendly;
it is full of compassion and produces
a harvest of good deeds;
it is free from prejudice and hypocrisy.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And goodness is the harvest that is produced
from the seeds the peacemakers plant in peace.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Strive for perfection; listen to my appeals;
agree with one another; live in peace.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And the God of love and peace will be with you.

entries.title: Christian Relationships
entries.firstLine: You are God's chosen race, his saints;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You are God's chosen race, his saints;
he loves you, and you should be clothed
in sincere compassion, in kindness
and humility, gentleness and patience.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Bear with one another; forgive each
other as soon as a quarrel begins.
The Lord has forgiven you;
now you must do the same.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Over all these clothes,
to keep them together and complete them, put on love.
And may the peace of Christ reign in your hearts,
because it is for this that you were called
together as parts of one body.
Always be thankful.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Let the message of Christ, in all its richness,
find a home with you. Teach each other,
and advise each other, in all wisdom.
With gratitude in your hearts sing psalms
and hymns and inspired songs to God;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: and never say or do anything except in
the name of the Lord Jesus,
giving thanks to God the Father through him.
May be joined with No.
for a longer passage.
LOVE FOR ONE ANOTHER: See also Nos.

entries.title: Lord, Who May Dwell in Your Sanctuary?
entries.firstLine: Lord, who may dwell in your sanctuary?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Lord, who may dwell in your sanctuary?
Who may live on your holy hill?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He whose walk is blameless
and who does what is righteous,
who speaks the truth from his heart and
has no slander on his tongue,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: who does his neighbor no wrong and casts
no slur on his fellow man,
who despises a vile man
but honors those who fear the Lord,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: who keeps his oath even when it hurts,
who lends his money without usury and
does not accept a bribe against the innocent.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He who does these things will never be shaken.

entries.title: The Requirements of God
entries.firstLine: With what shall I come before the Lord

parts.speaker: leader
lines: With what shall I come before the Lord
and bow down before 'the exalted God?
Shall I come before him with burnt offerings,
with calves a year old?
Will the Lord be pleased with thou sands of rams,
with ten thousand rivers of oil?
Shall I offer my firstborn for my transgression,
the fruit of my body for the sin of my soul?
He has showed you, O man, what is good.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And what does the Lord require of you?
To act justly and to love mercy and
to walk humbly with your God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Who is a God like you,
who pardons sin and forgives the transgression
of the remnant of his inheritance?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: You do not stay angry forever
but delight to show mercy.
You will again have compassion on us;
you will tread our sins underfoot and hurl
all our iniquities into the depths of the sea.
Return, O Israel, to the Lord your God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Your sins have been your downfall!
Take words with you and return to the Lord.
Say to him:

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Forgive all our sins and receive us graciously,
that we may offer the fruit of our lips."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "I will heal their waywardness and love them freely,
for my anger has turned away from them."
OBEDIENCE: See also Nos.

entries.title: Watchfulness
entries.firstLine: Deuteronomy 4, Colossians 2, 1 Peter 5,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Deuteronomy 4, Colossians 2, 1 Peter 5,
2 Thessalonians 2, and Mark 13, NJV
Only be careful,
and watch yourselves closely
so that you do not forget the things
your eyes have seen,
or let them slip from your heart as
long as you live.
Teach them to your children and
to their children after them.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Be careful not to forget the covenant of
the Lord your God that he made with you;
do not make for yourselves an idol in the form
of anything the Lord your God has forbidden.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: So then, just as you received Christ Jesus as Lord,
continue to live in him, rooted and built up in him,
strengthened in the faith as you were taught,
and overflowing with thankfulness.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: See to it that no one takes you captive
through hollow and deceptive philosophy,
which depends on human tradition and
the basic principles of this
world rather than on Christ.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Be self-controlled and alert.
Your enemy the devil prowls around
like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Resist him, standing firm in the faith,
because you know that your brothers
throughout the world are undergoing
the same kind of sufferings.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold
to the teachings we passed on to you,
whether by word of mouth or by letter.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Be on guard! Be alert!
You do not know when that time will come."
"What I say to you, I say to every one: 'Watch!'"

entries.title: Preparation for Christ's Coming
entries.firstLine: You know very well that the day of the Lord

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You know very well that the day of the Lord
will come like a thief in the night.
While people are saying, "Peace and safety,"
destruction will come on them suddenly,
as labor pains on a pregnant woman,
and they will not escape.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But you, brothers, are not in darkness
so that this day should surprise you like a thief.
You are all sons of the light and sons of the day.
We do not belong to the night or to the darkness.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: So then, let us not be like others, who are asleep,
but let us be alert and self-controlled.
For those who sleep, sleep at night,
and those who get drunk, get drunk at night.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But since we belong to the day,
let us be self-controlled,
putting on faith and love as a breastplate,
and the hope of salvation as a helmet.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For God did not appoint us to suffer wrath
but to receive salvation
through our Lord Jesus Christ.
He died for us so that,
whether we are awake or asleep,
we may live together with him.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Therefore encourage one another
and build each other up,
just as in fact you are doing.
WATCHFULNESS: See also No.

entries.title: Christian Warfare
entries.firstLine: Finally, build up your strength in union

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Finally, build up your strength in union
with the Lord and by means of his mighty power.
Put on all the armor that God gives you,
so that you will be able to stand up
against the Devil's evil tricks.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For we are not fighting against human beings
but against the wicked spiritual
forces in the heavenly world,
the rulers, authorities, and cosmic
powers of this dark age.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: So put on God's armor now!
Then when the evil day comes,
you will be able to resist the enemy's attacks,
and after fighting to the end,
you will still hold your ground.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: So stand ready,
with truth as a belt tight around your waist,
with righteousness as your breastplate,
and as your shoes the readiness to announce
the Good News of peace.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: At all times carry faith as a shield;
for with it you will be able to put out
all the burning arrows shot by the Evil One.
And accept salvation as a helmet,
and the word of God as the sword
which the Spirit gives you.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Do all this in prayer, asking for God's help.
Pray on every occasion, as the Spirit leads.
For this reason keep alert and never give up;
pray always for all God's people.
CHRISTIAN WARFARE: See also No.

entries.title: When the Lord Brought Back the Captives
entries.firstLine: When the Lord brought back the captives to Zion,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: When the Lord brought back the captives to Zion,
we were like men who dreamed.
Our mouths were filled with laughter
our tongue with songs of joy.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Then it was said among the nations,
"The Lord has done great things for them."
The Lord has done great things for us,
and we are filled with joy.
Restore our fortunes, O Lord,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: like streams in the Negev.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Those who sow in tears
will reap with songs of joy.
He who goes out weeping,
carrying seed to sow

parts.speaker: leader
lines: will return with songs of joy,
carrying sheaves with him.

entries.title: I Cry Aloud to the Lord
entries.firstLine: I cry aloud to the Lord;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I cry aloud to the Lord;
I lift up my voice to the Lord for mercy.
I pour out my complaint before him;
before him I tell my trouble.
When my spirit grows faint within me,
it is you who know my way.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: In the path where I walk
men have hidden a snare for me.
Look to my right and see;
no one is concerned for me.
I have no refuge;
no one cares for my life.
I cry to you, O Lord;

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I say, "You are my refuge,
my portion in the land of the living."
Listen to my cry,
for I am in desperate need;
rescue me from those who pursue me,
for they are too strong for me.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Set me free from my prison,
that I may praise your name.
Then the righteous will gather about me
because of your goodness to me.

entries.title: Tithes and Offerings
entries.firstLine: "'All the tithe of the land,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "'All the tithe of the land,
whether of the seed of the land
or of the fruit of the tree, is the Lord's.
It is holy to the Lord.'"

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Will a man rob God?
Yet you have robbed Me!
But you say,
'In what way have we robbed You.'
In tithes and offerings.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "You are cursed with a curse,
For you have robbed Me,
Even this whole nation.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Bring all the tithes into the storehouse,
That there may be food in My house,
And prove Me now in this,"
says the Lord of hosts,
"If I will not open for you
the windows of heaven
And pour out for you such blessing
That there will not be room enough to receive it.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes,
So that he will not destroy the fruit of your ground,
Nor shall the vine fail to bear fruit
for you in the field."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "And all nations will call you blessed,
For you will be a delightful land,"
Says the Lord of hosts.

entries.title: Generosity
entries.firstLine: See that you .... excel

parts.speaker: leader
lines: See that you .... excel
in this grace of giving....
For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ,
that though he was rich,
yet for your sakes he became poor,
so that you through his poverty
might become rich.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: If the willingness is there,
the gift is acceptable according to what one has,
not according to what he does not have.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Remember this:
Whoever sows sparingly will also reap sparingly,
and whoever sows generously
will also reap generously.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Each man should give what he has
decided in his heart to give,
not reluctantly or under compulsion,
for God loves a cheerful giver.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And God is able to make all grace abound to you,
so that in all things at all times,
having all that you need,
you will abound in every good work.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Now he who supplies seed to the sower
and bread for food will also supply
and increase your store of seed
and will enlarge the harvest
of your righteousness.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: You will made rich in every way
so that you can be generous on every occasion,
and through us your generosity will
result in thanksgiving to God.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: This service that you perform is not
only supplying the needs of God's people
but is also overflowing in many
expressions of thanks to God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Because of the service by which
you have proved yourselves,
men will praise God for the obedience
that accompanies your confession of
the gospel of Christ,
and for your generosity in sharing with them
and with everyone else.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And in their prayers for you their
hearts will go out to you,
because of the surpassing grace
God has given you.
Thanks be to God for his indescribable gift!
STEWARDSHIP: See also No.

entries.title: Our Daily Work
entries.firstLine: The Lord God took the man
entries.scriptureRef: Genesis 2, 3, Exodus 20, Ecclesiastes 5, 9, 2 Thessalonians 3, 1 Timothy 5, and Romans 12, NIV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The Lord God took the man
and put him in the Garden of Eden
to work it and take care of it.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Six days you shall labor and do all your work.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "By the sweat of your brow
you will eat your food."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The sleep of a laborer is sweet,
whether he eats little or much.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Whatever your hand finds to do,
do it with all your might.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: We gave you this rule:
"If a man will not work,
he shall not eat."

parts.speaker: leader
lines: If anyone does not provide for his relatives,
and especially for his immediate family,
he has denied the faith and
is worse than an unbeliever.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Never be lacking in zeal,
but keep your spiritual fervor,
serving the Lord.

entries.title: Temperance
entries.firstLine: 1 Corinthians 9, RSV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: 1 Corinthians 9, RSV
Teach what befits sound doctrine.
Bid the. older men be temperate, serious,
sensible, sound in faith, in love,
and in steadfastness.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Bid the older women likewise
to be reverent in behavior,
not to be slanderers or slaves to drink;
they are to teach what is good,
and so train the young women
to love their husbands and children....
Likewise urge the younger men
to control themselves.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Wine is a mocker, strong drink a brawler;
and whoever is led astray by it is not wise.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Who has woe? Who has sorrow?
Who has strife? Who has complaining?
Who has wounds without cause?
Who has redness of eyes?
Those who tarry long over wine,
those who go to try mixed wine.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Do not look at wine when it is red,
when it sparkles in the cup
and goes down smoothly.
At the last it bites like a serpent,
and stings like an adder.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Every athlete exercises self-control in all things.
They do it to receive a perishable wreath,
but we an imperishable.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For the grace of God has appeared
for the salvation of all men,
training us to renounce irreligion
and worldly passions,
and to live sober, upright,
and godly lives in this world,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: awaiting our blessed hope,
the appearing of the glory
Of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Healthful Living
entries.firstLine: My dear friend,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: My dear friend,
I hope everything is going happily with you
and that you are as well physically
as you are spiritually.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Your body, you know,
is the temple of the Holy Spirit,
who is in you since you received him from God.
You are not your own property;
you have been bought and paid for.
That is why you should use your
body for the glory of God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Whatever you cat, whatever you drink,
whatever you do at all,
do it for the glory of God.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: There is no need to worry;
but if there is anything you need, pray for it,
asking God for it with prayer and thanksgiving,
and that peace of God,
which is so much greater than we can understand,
will guard your hearts and your thoughts,
in Christ Jesus.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Finally, brothers,
fill your minds with everything that is true,
everything that is noble,
everything that is good and pure,
everything that we love and honour,
and everything that can be thought
virtuous or worthy of praise.
HEALTH AND WHOLENESS: See also No.

entries.title: Our Civic Duties
entries.firstLine: Everyone must submit himself

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Everyone must submit himself
to the governing authorities,
for there is no authority except
that which God has established.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The authorities that exist
have been established by God.
Consequently, he who rebels against
the authority is rebelling against
what God has instituted,
and those who do so will bring
judgment on themselves.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For rulers hold no terror for those who do right,
but for those who do wrong.
Do you want to be free from fear
of the one in authority?
Then do what is right and he will commend you.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For he is God's servant to do you good.
But if you do wrong, be afraid,
for he does not bear the sword for nothing.
He is God's servant,
an agent of wrath to bring punishment
on the wrongdoer.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Therefore, it is necessary
to submit to the authorities,
not only because of possible punishment
but also because of conscience.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: This is also why you pay taxes,
for the authorities are God's servants,
who give their full time to governing.
Give everyone what you owe him:
If you owe taxes, pay taxes;
if revenue, then revenue;
if respect, then respect,
if honor, then honor.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Let no debt remain outstanding,
except the continuing debt to love one another,
for he who loves his fellow man has fulfilled the law.

entries.title: Family Life
entries.firstLine: Love the Lord your God

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Love the Lord your God
with all your heart
and with all your soul
and with all your strength.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: These commandments that I give you today
are to be upon your hearts.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Impress them on your children.
Talk about them when you sit at home
and when you walk along the road,
when you lie down and when you get up.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Children, obey your parents in the Lord,
for this is right.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Honor your father and mother"
which is the first commandment with a promise
"that it may go well with you
and that you may enjoy long life on the earth."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Fathers, do not exasperate your children;
instead, bring them up in the training
and instruction of the Lord.

entries.title: The Christian Home
entries.firstLine: Never have grudges against others,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Never have grudges against others,
or lose your temper,
or raise your voice to anybody,
or call each other names,
or allow any sort of spitefulness.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Be friends with one another, and kind,
forgiving each other as readily as
God forgave you in Christ.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Try, then, to imitate God,
as children of his that he loves,
and follow Christ by loving as he loved you,
giving himself up in our place
as a fragrant offering and a sacrifice to God.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Among you there must be
not even a mention of fornication
or impurity in any of its forms,
or promiscuity:
this would hardly become the saints!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: There must be no coarseness,
or salacious talk and jokes,
all this is wrong for you;
raise your voices in thanksgiving instead.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: You were darkness once,
but now you are light in the Lord;
be like children of light.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Sing the words and tunes of the psalms
and hymns when you are together,
and go on singing and chanting
to the Lord in your hearts,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: so that always and everywhere
you are giving thanks to God who is our Father
in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Ecclesiastes 12, Proverbs 20, Psalm 119, Proverbs 3, and Psalm 103, NIV
entries.firstLine: Remember your Creator
entries.scriptureRef: Ecclesiastes 12, Proverbs 20, Psalm 119, Proverbs 3, and Psalm 103, NIV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Remember your Creator
in the days of your youth,
before the days of trouble come and
the years approach when you will say,
"I find no pleasure in them."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Even a child is known by his actions,
by whether his conduct is pure and right.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: How can a young man keep his way pure?
By living according to your word.
I seek you with all my heart;
do not let me stray from your commands.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: My son, do not forget my teaching,
but keep my commands in your heart,
for they will prolong your life
many years and bring you prosperity.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Let love and faithfulness never leave you;
bind them around your neck,
write them on the tablet of your heart.
Then you will win favor and a good name
in the sight of God and man.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Trust in the Lord with all your heart
and lean not on your own understanding;
in all your ways acknowledge him,
and he will make your paths straight.
Praise the Lord, O my soul,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: and forget not all his benefits....
He satisfies my desires with good things,
so that my youth is renewed like the eagle's.

entries.title: A Noble Wife
entries.firstLine: Who can find a virtuous wife?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Who can find a virtuous wife?
For her worth is far above rubies.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The heart of her husband safely trusts her;
So he will have no lack of gain.
She does him good and not evil
All the days of her life.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: She seeks wool and flax,
And willingly works with her hands.
She also rises while it is yet night,
And provides food for her house hold,
And a portion for her maidservants.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: She girds herself with strength,
And strengthens her arms....
She extends her hand to the poor,
Yes, she reaches out her hands to the needy.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Strength and honor are her clothing;
She shall rejoice in time to come.
She opens her mouth with wisdom,
And on her tongue is the law of kindness.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: She watches over the ways of her household,
And does not eat the bread of idleness.
Her children rise up and call her blessed;
Her husband also, and he praises her.

entries.title: Marriage
entries.firstLine: The Lord God said,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: The Lord God said,
"It is not good for the man to be alone.
I will provide a partner for him."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: The Lord God then built up the rib,
which he had taken out of the man,
into a woman.
He brought her to the man,
and the man said:

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Now this, at last,
bone from my bones,
flesh from my flesh!
this shall be called woman,
for from man was this taken."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "For this reason a man shall leave
his father and mother,
and be made one with his wife;
and the two shall become one flesh.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "It follows that they are no longer two individuals:
they are one flesh.
What God has joined together,
man must not separate."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Be subject to one another
out of reverence for Christ.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Wives, be subject to your husbands
as to the Lord;
for the man is the head of the woman,
just as Christ also is the head of the church.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Husbands, love your wives,
as Christ also loved the church
and gave himself up for it,
to consecrate it,
cleansing it by water and word,
so that he might present the church
to himself all glorious,
with no stain or wrinkle
or anything of the sort,
but holy and without blemish.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: In the same way
men also are bound to love their wives,
as they love their own bodies.
In loving his wife a man loves himself.
For no one ever hated his own body:
on the contrary, he provides and cares for it.
LOVE IN THE HOME: See also Nos.

entries.title: The Song of Moses and of Israel
entries.firstLine: "I will sing to the Lord,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "I will sing to the Lord,
For He has triumphed gloriously!
The horse and its rider He has
thrown into the sea!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "The Lord is my strength and song,
And He has become my salvation;
He is my God, and I will praise Him;
My Father's God, and I will exalt Him.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "The Lord is a man of war;
The Lord is His name.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Pharaoh's chariots and his army
He has cast into the sea;
His chosen captains also
are drowned in the Red Sea.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "The depths have covered them;
They sank to the bottom like a stone.
"Your right hand, O Lord,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: has become glorious in power;
Your right hand, O Lord,
has dashed the enemy in pieces.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "And in the greatness of Your excellence
You have overthrown those who rose against You;
You sent forth Your wrath
which consumed them like stubble.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "And with the blast of Your nostrils
The waters were gathered together;
The floods stood upright like a heap;
And the depths congealed in the heart of the sea.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "The enemy said, 'I will pursue,
I will overtake,
I will divide the spoil;
My desire shall be satisfied on them.
I will draw my sword,
My hand shall destroy them.'

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "You blew with Your wind,
the sea covered them;
They sank like lead in the mighty waters.
"Who is like You, O Lord, among the gods?

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Who is like You, glorious in holiness,
Fearful in praises, doing wonders?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "You stretched out Your right hand;
The earth swallowed them.
You in Your mercy have led forth
The people whom You have redeemed;
You have guided them in Your strength
To Your holy habitation.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "The people will hear and be afraid;
Sorrow will take hold of the inhabitants of Palestina.
Then the chiefs of Edom will be dismayed;
The mighty men of Moab,
Trembling will take hold of them;
All the inhabitants of Canaan will melt away.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Fear and dread will fall on them;
By the greatness of Your arm
They will be as still as a stone,
Till Your people pass over, O Lord,
Till the people pass over
Whom You have purchased.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "You will bring them in and plant them
In the mountain of Your inheritance,
In the place, O Lord, which You have made
For Your own dwelling,
The sanctuary, O Lord,
which You hands have established.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "The Lord shall reign forever and ever."

entries.title: Out of the Depths
entries.firstLine: Psalm 130, NKJV (De Profundis

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Psalm 130, NKJV (De Profundis
Out of the depths I have cried to You, O Lord;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Lord, hear my voice!
Let Your ears be attentive
To the voice of my supplications.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: If You, Lord, should mark iniquities,
O Lord, who could stand?

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But there is forgiveness with You,
That You may be feared.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: I wait for the Lord, my soul waits,
And in His word I do hope.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: My soul waits for the Lord
More than those who watch for the morning,
I say, more than those who watch for the morning.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: O Israel, hope in the Lord;
For with the Lord there is mercy,
And with Him is abundant redemption.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And He shall redeem Israel
From all his iniquities.

entries.title: Holy, Holy, Holy
entries.firstLine: Isaiah 6 (the Sanctus) and Mark 11, NKJV

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Isaiah 6 (the Sanctus) and Mark 11, NKJV
"Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of hosts;
The whole earth is full of His glory!"

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Hosanna!
'Blessed is He who comes in the
name of the Lord!'

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Blessed is the kingdom of our father David
That comes in the name of the Lord!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Hosanna in the highest!"

entries.title: The Lord's Prayer
entries.firstLine: Our Father which art in heaven,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Our Father which art in heaven,
Hallowed be thy name.
Thy kingdom come.
Thy will be done
in earth, as it is in heaven.
Give us this day our daily bread.
And forgive us our debts,
as we forgive our debtors.
And lead us not into temptation,
but deliver us from evil:
For thine is the kingdom,
and the power,
and the glory, for ever. Amen.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Luke 1, NKJV
"My soul magnifies the Lord,
And my spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "For He has regarded the lowly
state of His maidservant;
For behold, henceforth all generations
will call me blessed.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "For He who is mighty has done
great things for me,
And holy is His name.
And His mercy is on those who fear Him
From generation to generations.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "He has shown strength with His arm;
He has scattered the proud in the
imagination of their hearts.
He has put down the mighty from their thrones,
And exalted the lowly.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "He has filled the hungry with good things,
And the rich He has sent away empty.
He has helped His servant Israel,
In remembrance of His mercy,
As He spoke to our fathers,
To Abraham and to his seed forever."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Commonly called The Magnificat.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Luke 1, NKJV
"Blessed is the Lord God of Israel,
For He has visited and redeemed His people,
And has raised up a horn of salvation for us
In the house of His servant David,
As He spoke by the mouth of His holy prophets,
Who have been since the world began,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "That we should be saved from our enemies
And from the hand of all who hate us,
To perform the mercy promised to our fathers
And to remember His holy covenant,
The oath which He swore to our father Abraham:

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "To grant us that we,
Being delivered from the hand of our enemies,
Might serve Him without fear,
In holiness and righteousness before
Him all the days of our life.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "And you, child, will be called the
prophet of the Highest;
For you will go before the face
of the Lord to prepare His ways,
To give knowledge of salvation to His people
By the remission of their sins,
Through the tender mercy of our God,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "With which the Dayspring
from on high has visited us;
To give light to those who sit in darkness
and the shadow of death,
To guide our feet into the way of peace,"

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Commonly called The Benedictus.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Luke 2, Jerusalem
"Now, Master, you can let
your servant go in peace,
just as you promised;
because my eyes have seen the salvation
which you have prepared for all
the nations to see,
a light to enlighten the pagans
and the glory of your people Israel."

entries.title: Paul's Doxology
entries.firstLine: Oh, the depth of the riches

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Oh, the depth of the riches
of the wisdom and knowledge of God!

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: How unsearchable his judgments,
and his paths beyond tracing out!

parts.speaker: leader
lines: "Who has known the mind of the Lord?
Or who has been his counselor?"

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: "Who has ever given to God,
that God should repay him?"

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For from him and through him
and to him are all things.
To him be the glory forever! Amen.

entries.title: Spiritual Wisdom
entries.firstLine: We speak wisdom among those who are mature,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: We speak wisdom among those who are mature,
yet not the wisdom of this age,
nor of the rulers of this age,
who are coming to nothing.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But we speak the wisdom of God in a mystery,
the hidden wisdom which God ordained
before the ages for our glory,
which none of the rulers of this age knew;
for had they known,
they would not have crucified the Lord of glory.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: But as it is written:
"Eye has not seen, nor ear heard,
Nor have entered into the heart of man
The things which God has prepared
for those who love Him."

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But God has revealed them to us
through His Spirit.
For the Spirit searches all things,
yes, the deep things of God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For what man knows the things of a man
except the spirit of the man which is in him?
Even so no one knows the things of God
except the Spirit of God.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Now we have received,
not the spirit of the world,
but the Spirit who is from God,
that we might know the things
that have been freely given to us by God.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: These things we also speak,
not in words which man's wisdom
teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches,
comparing spiritual things with spiritual.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But the natural man does not receive
the things of the Spirit of God,
for they are foolishness to him;
nor can he know them,
because they are spiritually discerned.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: But he who is spiritual judges all things,
yet he himself is rightly judged by no one.
For "Who has known the mind of the
Lord that he may instruct Him?"

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: But we have the mind of Christ.

entries.title: Things Seen and Unseen
entries.firstLine: We do not lose heart.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: We do not lose heart.
Even though our outward man is perishing,
yet the inward man is being renewed
day by day.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: For our light affliction,
which is but for a moment,
is working for us a far more exceeding
and eternal weight of glory,
while we do not look at the things
which are seen,
but at the things which are not seen.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For the things which are seen are temporary,
but the things which are not seen are eternal.

entries.title: The Plan of Salvation
entries.firstLine: Blessed be God the Father of our

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Blessed be God the Father of our
Lord Jesus Christ,
who has blessed us with all the
spiritual blessings of heaven in Christ.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Before the world was made,
he chose us, chose us in Christ,
to be holy and spodess,
and to live through love in his presence,
determining that we should become
his adopted sons, through Jesus Christ
for his own kind purposes,
to make us praise the glory of his grace,
his free gift to us in the Beloved,
in whom, through his blood,
we gain our freedom, the forgiveness of our sins.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Such is the richness of the grace
which he has showered on us
in all wisdom and insight.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He has let us know the mystery of his purpose,
the hidden plan he so kindly made in Christ
from the beginning to act upon
when the times had run their course to the end:
that he would bring everything
together under Christ, as head,
everything in the heavens and
everything on earth.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: And it is in him that we were claimed as God's own,
chosen from the beginning,
under the predetermined plan of the one
who guides all things as he decides by his own will;
chosen to be, for his greater glory,
the people who would put their
hopes in Christ before he came.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: Now you too, in him, have heard the message
of the truth and the good news of your salvation,
and have believed it;
and you too have been stamped with the seal
of the Holy Spirit of the Promise,
the pledge of our inheritance which brings freedom
for those whom God has taken for his own,
to make his glory praised.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: PhiliPpians 2, NKJV
Christ Jesus,... being in the form of God,
did not consider it robbery
to be equal with God,
but made Himself of no reputation,
taking the form of a servant,
and coming in the likeness of men.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: And being found in appearance as a man,
He humbled Himself and became obedient
to the point of death,
even the death of the cross.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: Therefore God also has highly exalted Him
and given Him the name which is above every name,

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: that at the name of Jesus
every knee should bow,
of those in heaven,
and of those on earth,
and of those under the earth,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: and that every tongue should confess
that Jesus Christ is Lord,
to the glory of God the Father.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: This is perhaps the earliest Christian hymn.

entries.title: In Praise of Christ
entries.firstLine: He is the image of the invisible God,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: He is the image of the invisible God,
the first-born of all creation;

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: for in him all things were created,
in heaven and on earth,
visible and invisible,

parts.speaker: leader
lines: whether thrones or dominions
or principalities or authorities
all things were created through him
and for him.

parts.speaker: congregation
lines: He is before all things,
and in him all things hold together.
He is the head of the body, the church;
he is the beginning,
the first-born from the dead,
that in everything he might be pre-eminent.

parts.speaker: leader
lines: For in him all the fulness of God
was pleased to dwell,
and through him to reconcile to himself all things,
whether on earth or in heaven,
making peace by the blood of his cross.

entries.title: The Incarnate Word
entries.firstLine: Something which has existed since the beginning,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Something which has existed since the beginning,
that we have heard,
and we have seen with our own eyes;
that we have watched and touched with our hands:
the Word, who is life this is our subject.
That life was made visible:
we saw it and we are giving our testimony,
telling you of the eternal life
which was with the Father
and has been made visible to us.
What we have seen and heard
we are telling you so that you too
may be in union with us,
as we are in union with the Father
and with his Son Jesus Christ.
We are writing this to you
to make our own joy complete.

entries.title: Psalm 29:1,2, NKJV
entries.firstLine: Give unto the Lord, O you mighty ones,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Give unto the Lord, O you mighty ones,
Give unto the Lord glory and strength.
Give unto the Lord the glory due to His name;
Worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

entries.title: Psalm 29:1,2, NKJV
entries.firstLine: As a deer longs for a stream of cool water,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: As a deer longs for a stream of cool water,
so I long for you, O God.
I thirst for you, the living God.
When can I go and worship in your presence?

entries.title: Psalm 43:3, 4, NIV
entries.firstLine: Send forth your light and your truth,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Send forth your light and your truth,
let them guide me;

parts.speaker: unison
lines: let them bring me to your holy mountain,
to the place where you dwell.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Then will I go to the altar of God,
to God, my joy and my delight.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: I will praise you with the harp,
O God, my God.

entries.title: Psalm 47:5-7, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: God rises to shouts of acclamation,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: God rises to shouts of acclamation,
Yahweh rises to a blast of trumpets,
let the music sound for our God,
let it sound,
let the music sound for our King,
let it sound! God is king of the whole world:
play your best in his honour!

entries.title: Psalm 48:9-11, 14, TEV
entries.firstLine: Inside your Temple, O God,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Inside your Temple, O God,
we think of your constant love.
You are praised by people everywhere,
and your fame extends over all the earth.
You rule with justice;
let the people of Zion be glad!

parts.speaker: unison
lines: This God is our God forever and ever;
he will lead us for all time to come

entries.title: Psalm 52:8, 9, NJV
entries.firstLine: I trust in God's unfailing love for ever and ever.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: I trust in God's unfailing love for ever and ever.
I will praise you forever for what you have done;
in your name I will hope, for your name is good.
I will praise you in the presence of your saints.

entries.title: Psalm 57:9-11, NKJV
entries.firstLine: I will praise You, O Lord, among the peoples;

parts.speaker: unison
lines: I will praise You, O Lord, among the peoples;
I will sing to You among the nations.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: For Your mercy reaches unto the heavens,
And Your truth unto the clouds.
Be exalted, O God, above the heavens;

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Let Your glory be above all the earth.

entries.title: Psalm 63:1-5, adapted
entries.firstLine: O God, You are our God.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: O God, You are our God.
Earnestly we seek You today.
Our souls thirst for You,
our whole being longs for You.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Because we have seen You in the sanctuary
and beheld Your power and glory, we can respond.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Lord, Your love is better than life itself,
and we declare that our lips will glorify You.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: We will praise You as long as we live,
and in Your name we will lift up
our hands to do Your work.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Lord we will be stisfied if
You feed us,
and we will now sing praises to Your name.

entries.title: Psalm 65:1-4, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: Praise is rightfully yours, God, in Zion.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Praise is rightfully yours, God, in Zion.
Vows to you must be fulfilled,
for you answer prayer.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: All flesh must come to you
with all its sins;
though our faults overpower us,
you blot them out.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Happy the man you choose,
whom you invite to live in your courts.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Fill us with the good things of your house,
of your holy Temple.

entries.title: Psalm 67:1, 2, 4, 7, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: May God show kindness and bless us,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: May God show kindness and bless us,
and make his face smile on us!
For then the earth will acknowledge your ways
and all the nations will know
of your power to save.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Let the nations shout and sing for joy,
since you dispense true justice to the world;
you dispense strict justice to the peoples,
on earth you rule the nations.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: May God bless us, and let him be feared
to the very ends of the earth.

entries.title: Psalm 89:8-11, 13-15, TEV
entries.firstLine: Lord God Almighty,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Lord God Almighty,
none is as mighty as you;
in all things you are faithful, O Lord.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: You rule over the powerful sea;
you calm its angry waves....
Heaven is yours, the earth also;
you made the world and everything in it.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: How powerful you are!
How great is your strength!
Your kingdom is founded
on righteousness and justice;
love and faithfulness are shown in all you do.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: How happy are the people
who worship you with songs,
who live in the light of your kindness!

entries.title: Psalm 92:1-5, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: It is good to give thanks to Yahweh,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: It is good to give thanks to Yahweh,
to play in honour of your name, Most High,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: to proclaim your love at daybreak
and your faithfulness all through the night
to the music of the zither and lyre,
to the rippling of the harp.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: I am happy, Yahweh, at what you have done;
at your achievements I joyfully exclaim,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Great are your achievements, Yahweh,
immensely deep your thoughts!"

entries.title: Psalm 95:6, 7, KJV
entries.firstLine: O come, let us worship and bow down:

parts.speaker: unison
lines: O come, let us worship and bow down:
let us kneel before the Lord our maker.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: For he is our God;
and we are the people of his pasture,
and the sheep of his hand.

entries.title: Psalm 96:8, 9, KJV
entries.firstLine: Give unto the Lord the glory

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Give unto the Lord the glory
due unto his name:
bring an offering,
and come into his courts.
O worship the Lord
in the beauty of holiness:
fear before him, all the earth.

entries.title: Psalm 98, RSV
entries.firstLine: O sing to the Lord a new song,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: O sing to the Lord a new song,
for he has done marvelous things!
His right hand and his holy arm
have gotten him victory.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: The Lord has made known his victory,
he has revealed his vindication
in the sight of the nations.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: He has remembered his steadfast love
and faithfulness to the house of Israel.
All the ends of the earth have seen
the victory of our God.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Make a joyful noise to the Lord, all the earth;
break forth into joyous song and sing praises!

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Sing praises to the Lord with the lyre,
with the lyre and the sound of melody!
With trumpets and the sound of the horn
make a joyful noise before the King, the Lord!

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Let the sea roar, and all that fills it;
the world and those who dwell in it!
Let the floods clap their hands;
let the hills sing for joy together
before the Lord,
for he comes to judge the earth.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: He will judge the world with righteousness,
and the peoples with equity.

entries.title: Psalm 99:5, NKJV
entries.firstLine: Exalt the Lord our God,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Exalt the Lord our God,
and worship at His footstool;
For He is holy.

entries.title: Psalm 100:2-5, NJV
entries.firstLine: Serve the Lord with gladness;

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Serve the Lord with gladness;
come before him with joyful songs.
Enter his gates with thanksgiving
and his courts with praise;
give thanks to him and praise his name.
For the Lord is good and
his love endures forever.

entries.title: Psalm 107:31, 32, KJV
entries.firstLine: Oh that men would praise the Lord

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Oh that men would praise the Lord
for his goodness,
and for his wonderful works
to the children of men!
Let them exalt him also in the
congregation of the people,
and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

entries.title: Psalm 117, NEB
entries.firstLine: Praise the Lord, all nations,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Praise the Lord, all nations,
extol him, all you peoples;
for his love protecting us is strong,
the Lord's constancy is everlasting.
O praise the Lord.

entries.title: Psalm 118:24-26, TEV
entries.firstLine: This is the day of the Lord's victory;

parts.speaker: unison
lines: This is the day of the Lord's victory;
let us be happy, let us celebrate!...
May God bless the one who comes in
the name of the Lord!

entries.title: Psalm 118:19-21, NJV
entries.firstLine: Open for me the gates of righteousness;

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Open for me the gates of righteousness;
I will enter and give thanks to the Lord.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: This is the gate of the Lord
through which the righteous may enter.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: I will give you thanks,
for you answered me;
you have become my salvation

entries.title: Psalm 122:1; 118:24, RSV
entries.firstLine: I was glad when they said to me,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: I was glad when they said to me,
"Let us go to the house of the Lord!"

parts.speaker: unison
lines: This is the day which the Lord has made;
let us rejoice and be glad in it!

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Both are excellent as separate Calls.

entries.title: Psalm 134, TEV
entries.firstLine: Come, praise the Lord, all his servants,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Come, praise the Lord, all his servants,
all who serve in his Temple at night.
Raise your hands in prayer in the Temple,
and praise the Lord!
May the Lord, who made heaven and earth,
bless you from Zion!

entries.title: Psalm 135:1-3, NEB
entries.firstLine: O praise the Lord.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: O praise the Lord.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Praise the name of the Lord;
praise him, you servants of the Lord,
who stand in the house of the Lord,
in the temple courts of our God.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Praise the Lord, for that is good;
honour his name with psalms,
for that is pleasant.

entries.title: Isaiah 12:4-6, TEV
entries.firstLine: "Give thanks to the Lord!

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Give thanks to the Lord!
Call for him to help you!
Tell all the nations what he has done!
Tell them how great he is!

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Sing to the Lord because of the
great things he has done.
Let the whole world hear the news.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Let everyone who lives in Zion shout and sing!
Israel's holy God is great,
and he lives among his people."

entries.title: Isaiah 12:4-6, TEV
entries.firstLine: Sing a new hymn to Yahweh!

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Sing a new hymn to Yahweh!
Let his praise resound
from the ends of the earth,
let the sea and all that it holds sing his praises,
the islands and those who inhabit them.
Let the desert and its cities raise their voice....
Let the inhabitants...
shout from the mountain tops.
Let them give glory to Yahweh.

entries.title: Isaiah 55:6, 7, NIV
entries.firstLine: Seek the Lord while he may be found;

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Seek the Lord while he may be found;
call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way
and the evil man his thoughts.
Let him turn to the Lord,
and he will have mercy on him,
and to our God, for he will freely pardon.

entries.title: Isaiah 63:7, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: Let me sing the praises of Yahweh's goodness,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Let me sing the praises of Yahweh's goodness,
and of his marvellous deeds,
in return for all that he has done for us
and for the great kindness
he has shown us in his mercy
and in his boundless goodness.

entries.title: Jeremiah 29:12, 13, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: When you call to me,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: When you call to me,
and come to plead with me,
I will listen to you.
When you seek me you shall find me,
when you seek me with all your heart.

entries.title: Habakkuk 2:20, KJV
entries.firstLine: The Lord is in his holy temple:

parts.speaker: unison
lines: The Lord is in his holy temple:
let all the earth keep silence before him.

entries.title: Matthew 11:28-30, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: "Come to me, all you who labour

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Come to me, all you who labour
and are overburdened,
and I will give you rest.
Shoulder my yoke and learn from me,
for I am gentle and humble in heart,
and you will find rest for your souls.
Yes, my yoke is easy and my burden light."

entries.title: Matthew 18:20; John 4:23,24, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: "Where two or three meet in my name,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Where two or three meet in my name,
I shall be there with them."

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "The hour will come,
in fact it is here already,
when true worshippers will worship
the Father in spirit and truth:

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "that is the kind of worshipper
the Father wants.
God is spirit, and those who worship
must worship in spirit and truth."

entries.title: Hebrews 4:14, 16, TEV
entries.firstLine: Let us, then, hold firmly to the faith we profess.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Let us, then, hold firmly to the faith we profess.
For we have a great High Priest
who has gone into the very presence of God,
Jesus, the Son of God.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Let us be brave, then,
and approach God's throne,
where there is grace.
There we will receive mercy and find grace
to help us just when we need it.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:19-22, NEB
entries.firstLine: So now, my friends,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: So now, my friends,
the blood of Jesus makes us free
to enter boldly
into the sanctuary by the new,
living way which he has opened for us....
We have, moreover, a great priest
set over the household of God;
so let us make our approach in sincerity
of heart and full assurance of faith.

entries.title: Hebrews 10:23-25, NIV
entries.firstLine: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess,
for he who promised is faithful.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: And let us consider how we may spur
one another on toward love and good deeds.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Let us not give up meeting together,
as some are in the habit of doing,
but let us encourage one another,
and all the more as you see the Day approaching.

entries.title: Revelation 22:17, NEB
entries.firstLine: "Come!" say the Spirit and the bride.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Come!" say the Spirit and the bride.
"Come!" let each hearer reply.
Come forward, you who are thirsty;
accept the water of life,
a free gift to all who desire it.

entries.title: Job 19:25-27, NKJV
entries.firstLine: "I know that my Redeemer lives,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "I know that my Redeemer lives,
And He shall stand at last on the earth;
And after my skin is destroyed,
this I know, That in my flesh I shall see God,
Whom I shall see for myself,
And my eyes shall behold,
and not another."

entries.title: Psalm 55:22, RSV
entries.firstLine: Cast your burden on the Lord,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Cast your burden on the Lord,
and he will sustain you;
he will never permit
the righteous to be moved.

entries.title: Psalm 68:19, 20, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: Blessed be the Lord day after day,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Blessed be the Lord day after day,
the God who saves us and bears our burdens!
This God of ours is a God who saves,
to the Lord Yahweh belong the ways
of escape from death.

entries.title: Isaiah 1:18,19, NIV
entries.firstLine: "Come now, let us reason together,"

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Come now, let us reason together,"
says the Lord.
"Though your sins are like scarlet,
they shall be as white as snow;
though they are red as crimson,
they shall be like wool.
If you are willing and obedient,
you will eat the best from the land."

entries.title: Isaiah 41:10, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: "Do not be afraid, for I am with you;

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Do not be afraid, for I am with you;
stop being anxious and watchful,
for I am your God.
I give you strength, I bring you help,
I uphold you with my victorious right hand."

entries.title: Matthew 6:14, TEV
entries.firstLine: "If you forgive others the wrongs

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "If you forgive others the wrongs
they have done to you,
your Father in heaven will also forgive you."

entries.title: Psalm 103:8-12, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: Yahweh is tender and compassionate,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Yahweh is tender and compassionate,
slow to anger, most loving; ...
he never treats us, never punishes us,
as our guilt and our sins deserve.
No less than the height of heaven over earth
is the greatness of his love
for those who fear him;
he takes our sins farther away
than the east is from the west.

entries.title: Matthew 7:7, 8, NEB
entries.firstLine: "Ask, and you will receive;

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Ask, and you will receive;
seek, and you will find;
knock, and the door will be opened.
For everyone who asks receives,
he who seeks finds,
and to him who knocks,
the door will be opened."
Iframes not supported.
Trigger
x

entries.title: Romans 8:1, NKJV
entries.firstLine: There is therefore now no condemnation

parts.speaker: unison

to those who are in Christ Jesus,
who do not walk according to the flesh,
but according to the Spirit.

entries.title: 1 John 1:9, KJV
entries.firstLine: If we confess our sins,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: If we confess our sins,
he is faithful
and just to forgive us our Sins,
and to cleanse us
from all unrighteousness.

entries.title: 1 John 2:1,2, NIV
entries.firstLine: If anybody does sin,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: If anybody does sin,
we have one who speaks to the Father
in our defense�Jesus Christ,
the Righteous One.
He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins,
and not only for ours but also
for the sins of the whole world.

entries.title: 1 John 5:11-13, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: This is the testimony:

parts.speaker: unison
lines: This is the testimony:
God has given us eternal life
and this life is in his Son;
anyone who has the Son has life,
anyone who does not have the Son
does not have life.
I have written all this to you
so that you who believe in the name
of the Son of God
may be sure that you have eternal life.

entries.title: 1 John 5:14, 15, NIV
entries.firstLine: This is the assurance

parts.speaker: unison
lines: This is the assurance
we have in approaching God:
that if we ask anything
according to his will,
he hears us.
And if we know that he hears us
whatever we ask�
we know that we have what we asked of him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 29:11-13, NIV
entries.firstLine: "Yours, O Lord, is the greatness

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Yours, O Lord, is the greatness
and the power and the glory
and the majesty and the splendor,
for everything in heaven and earth is yours.
"Yours, O Lord, is the kingdom;

parts.speaker: unison
lines: you are exalted as head over all.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Wealth and honor come from you;
you are the ruler of all things.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "In your hands are strength and power
to exalt and give strength to all.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Now, our God, we give you thanks,
and praise your glorious name."

entries.title: Psalm 50:10, 11, 14, TEV
entries.firstLine: "All the animals in the forest are mime

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "All the animals in the forest are mime
and the cattle on thousands of hills.
All the wild birds are mine
and all living things in the fields.
Let the giving of thanks be your
sacrifice to God,
and give the Almighty all that you promised."

entries.title: Psalm 54:6, NIV
entries.firstLine: I will sacrifice a freewill offering to you;

parts.speaker: unison
lines: I will sacrifice a freewill offering to you;
I will praise your name,
O Lord, for it is good.

entries.title: Psalm 56:12, 13, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: I must fulfil the vows I made you, God;

parts.speaker: unison
lines: I must fulfil the vows I made you, God;
I shall pay you my thank-offerings,
for you have rescued me from Death
to walk in the presence of God
in the light of the living.

entries.title: Psalm 96:8, TEV
entries.firstLine: Praise the Lord's glorious name;

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Praise the Lord's glorious name;
bring an offering
and come into his Temple.

entries.title: Proverbs 3:9, NEB
