parts.speaker: unison
lines: Honour the Lord with your wealth
as the first charge on all your earnings.

entries.title: Reading 900
entries.firstLine: Malachi 3:10. RSV

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Malachi 3:10. RSV
"Bring the full tithes into the storehouse,
that there may be food in my house;
and thereby put me to the test,
says the Lord of hosts,
if I will not open the windows
of heaven for you and pour down for you
an overflowing blessing."

entries.title: Matthew 5:16, RSV
entries.firstLine: "Let your light so shine before men,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Let your light so shine before men,
that they may see your good works
and give glory to your Father
who is in heaven."

entries.title: Romans 12:6-8, NIV
entries.firstLine: We have different gifts,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: We have different gifts,
according to the grace given us.
If a man's gift is prophesying,
let him use it in proportion to his faith.
If it is serving, let him serve;
if it is teaching, let him teach;
if it is encouraging, let him encourage;
if it is contributing to the needs of others,
let him give generously;
if it is leadership,
let him govern diligently;
if it is showing mercy,
let him do it cheerfully.

entries.title: 2 Corinthians 8:3-5, RSV
entries.firstLine: They gave according to their means,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: They gave according to their means,
and beyond their means,
of their own free will,
but first they gave themselves to the Lord.

entries.title: 2 Corinthians 8:9, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: Remember how generous the Lord Jesus was:

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Remember how generous the Lord Jesus was:
he was rich, but he became poor
for your sake,
to make you rich out of his poverty.

entries.title: 2 Corinthians 9:6, 7, NEB
entries.firstLine: Remember:

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Remember:
sparse sowing, sparse reaping;
sow bountifully,
and you will reap bountifully.
Each person should give as
he has decided for himself;
there should be no reluctance,
no sense of compulsion;
God loves a cheerful giver.

entries.title: 2 Corinthians 9:13-15, NEB
entries.firstLine: Many will give honour to God

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Many will give honour to God
when they see how humbly you obey him
and how faithfully you confess
the gospel of Christ;
and will thank him for your liberal contribution
to their need and to the general good....
Thanks be to God for his gift beyond words!

entries.title: Genesis 31:49, NKJV
entries.firstLine: "May the Lord watch between you and me

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "May the Lord watch between you and me
when we are absent one from another."

entries.title: Numbers 6:24-26, NIV
entries.firstLine: "'The Lord bless you and keep you;

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "'The Lord bless you and keep you;
the Lord make his face shine upon you
and be gracious to you;
the Lord turn his face toward you
and give you peace.'"

entries.title: Joshua 1:9, NIV
entries.firstLine: "Be strong and courageous.

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Be strong and courageous.
Do not be terrified;
do not be discouraged,
for the Lord your God
will be with you
wherever you go."

entries.title: Psalm 19:14, NKJV
entries.firstLine: Let the words of my mouth

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Let the words of my mouth
and the meditation of my heart
Be acceptable in Your sight,
O Lord, my strength and my redeemer.

entries.title: Isaiah 60:1,19, NIV
entries.firstLine: "Arise, shine, for your light has come,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: "Arise, shine, for your light has come,
and the glory of the Lord rises upon you."
"The Lord will be your everlasting light,
and your God will be your glory."

entries.title: Romans 15:13, NIV
entries.firstLine: May the God of hope fill you with all joy

parts.speaker: unison
lines: May the God of hope fill you with all joy
and peace as you trust in him,
so that you may overflow with hope
by the power of the Holy Spirit.

entries.title: 2 Corinthians 13:14, RSV
entries.firstLine: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ

parts.speaker: unison
lines: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ
and the love of God.
nd the fellowship of the Holy Spirit
be with you all.

entries.title: Ephesians 3:20, 21, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: Glory be to him whose power,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Glory be to him whose power,
working in us,
can do infinitely more than
we can ask or imagine;
glory be to him from generation
to generation in the Church
and in Christ Jesus for ever and ever.
Amen.

entries.title: Jude 24, 25, Jerusalem
entries.firstLine: Glory be to him

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Glory be to him
who can keep you from falling
and bring you safe to his glorious presence,
innocent and happy.
To God, the only God,
who saves us through Jesus Christ our Lord,
be the glory, majesty, authority and power,
which he had before time began,
now and for ever. Amen.

entries.title: Philippians 4:8, 9, RSV
entries.firstLine: Finally, brethren,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Finally, brethren,
whatever is true,
whatever is honorable,
whatever is just,
whatever is pure,
whatever is lovely,
whatever is gracious,
if there is any excellence,
if there is anything worthy of praise,
think about these things.
What you have learned and received
and heard and Seen in me, do:
and the God of peace will be with you.

entries.title: 1 Timothy 1:17, KJV
entries.firstLine: Now unto the King eternal,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Now unto the King eternal,
immortal, invisible, the only wise God,
be honour and glory for ever and ever.
Amen.

entries.title: 1 Timothy 1:17, KJV
entries.firstLine: Grace to you, and peace,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Grace to you, and peace,
from God our Father
and the Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: Hebrews 13:20, 21, NIV
entries.firstLine: May the God of peace,

parts.speaker: unison
lines: May the God of peace,
who through the blood of the eternal covenant
brought back from the dead our Lord Jesus,
that great Shepherd of the sheep,
equip you with everything good
for doing his will,
and may he work in us what is pleasing to him,
through Jesus Christ,
to whom be glory for ever and ever.
Amen.

entries.title: 2 Peter 3:18, NEB
entries.firstLine: Grow in the grace

parts.speaker: unison
lines: Grow in the grace
and in the knowledge of our Lord
and Saviour Jesus Christ.
To him be glory now and for all eternity!
